title: Herceg chart spec
description:
A chart as herceg's portable spec writes it (version 1): what Python's Chart.to_spec() writes, and loadSpec and validateSpec read. Generated from the spec's TypeScript types by scripts/generate-spec-schema.mjs.

validateSpec and loadSpec also check what this schema cannot say:
- Fields name columns of the table an option reads, of the kind it needs: numbers, times, categories, or geometry (dodged, jittered, and swarmed points and dodged lines need a category position; a tree's color is a field of its path), and the values a channel takes as they are (a scale of type identity) are what the channel takes.
- A string that may be a field or a constant (a color, a shape) names exactly one of them: a field of the table, or a color or shape that is no field.
- A mark of several value fields takes no series field, and what is read once per series (a style map's field, a legend entry's field) does not change within one.
- Names refer to what the spec declares: a mark's data, a derived table's source, and a table's origin to a table of data (which a mark of a spec of several tables names); a panel to one of panels; a scale to x, y, yRight, or one of scales, of the kind the option needs; a mark to a mark's id; a colorbar to a color scale of the chart's marks; a view's or visibility's axis and panels to the chart's; a buffer to one delivered with the spec.
- Rules and regions at a field's thresholds need the chart's fields to give that field thresholds, in a table the chart's marks read.
- Tables hold what their columns' types say, and what counts their rows agrees with them: columns are of one length; times are epoch milliseconds or ISO 8601 times; category codes lie within their dictionary; geometry is nested as GeoArrow nests it (offsets start at 0, ascend, and end at the count of what they divide), at longitudes within ±540 and latitudes within ±90 degrees; a selection's rows are positions among its table's; and a dendrogram labels one leaf more than it has merges.
- A layout's cells lie within its rows and columns and do not overlap, and every panel is placed once.
- Ranges ascend (domains, colorDomain, radiusRange, a view's extent, a gauge's and a field display's min and max, a fit box's south and north, a time break's from and to, a value mapping's between), as do bin edges, thresholds, and a gauge's bands within its range.
- Options of a kind of chart need its marks: projection geographic marks; z, camera, and boxAspect 3D marks, whose box takes no zIndex or padding, and whose axes take a count of ticks and Intl formats; drillRoot a tree; a chart's or a panel's drag a graph.
- Options that go together or exclude each other beyond the forms here: text at a place or following a mark, once; a radar's category and value, or its fields; dodging with neither bands nor stacks; a contour's lines or bands, and two thresholds a band; a band's labels along one of its edges; itemKey with data; a rule in the legend with a label; a dragged rule at a value; a graph's node fields with a nodes table; color options of a map with a number color field; a facet's field, or row and column; an operation's field; a range's two ends (an area's, an error bar's) placed alike; a label's leader only where labels move (overlap "move"); points' outline (stroke, strokeWidth) of one value; an option given once, not also through encode; series' names (series: true) only for channels that read them; a list of channels' entries only up to the first that always gives an output; a series label's attachment, side, and edge only where it does not follow its series; several value fields only along the mark's direction (several x fields with orient "y"); a label's content that writes its value or names its series only where the label has one; a guide's room only on y axes, whose labels an ellipsis shortens; an axis guide's side along its axis (top or bottom for x, left or right for y); a stack's inside-out order only for shares or a stream; ticks' fiscal years only by months or years, and their anchor only by elapsed time.
- Colors are CSS colors (hex, rgb(), hsl(), var(), or names), a colors option names a known scheme, and color ramps (a theme's sequential and diverging, a scale's range of colors) are "#rgb" or "#rrggbb" colors.
- Conditions (filter, where) give true or false, and each operator takes the number and kinds of operands it reads (["field", name], numbers for "+").
- A scale of scales named other than x, y, or yRight gives its type.
- locale is a language tag, and timeZone a time zone, the JavaScript engine knows, and Intl's options (digits, currencies, units, calendars, numbering systems) are what its Intl takes.
- Number patterns (",.2f") and time intervals ("6 hours") are written as herceg reads them; a break's dates ("YYYY-MM-DD") are days of the calendar, "24:00" ends its hours but starts none, and its weekdays and hours leave time to show (not every day, not a span of no time or of a whole day).
- Options of a kind of value need values of that kind, which the data decides: times (time formats and intervals, breaks and seams, and a line's gaps and breaks of time) a time axis, and numbers (number formats, steps, and tick values) a linear one, or a tree's labels, which write numbers.
- Charts are large enough for what they hold: a scale's padding in pixels leaves room in its plot, a facet's panels and a layout's tracks fit its chart, and static exports (SVG, PNG, PDF) lay out at most 16384 pixels a side and draw no selection.

This schema refuses what validateSpec takes in:
- A 2D histogram's axis: its type has none, and validateSpec takes "left", where it draws anyway.
- Intl's options, which herceg hands to Intl as given: the schema takes the values their TypeScript types name, while Intl converts others (hour12 "true") and a format leaves out what it does not read (a date's options in a number's).
- Dash lengths below 0, which validateSpec takes in an option's dash (not in a dash channel's).
- A 3D mark's zIndex of 0, the default, which its type leaves out and validateSpec takes.
- An expression's operators, which herceg checks as it draws: where a mark does not read the option holding the expression (a region's encode.color beside its fill), it takes an operator the schema does not name.

AggregateSpec.description: An aggregate: its operation, the number field it reads (none for count), and its name.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Milliseconds a change takes; 0 shows it at once.

values.title: Values
values.description: Marks move from the values shown to new ones when a table's values change in place or are replaced (`replace`, `set`, `setColumn`, `reset`), and axes whose automatic domains change move with them, as well as the axes moving to views asked for: bars, pie slices, gauges, points (by row, so not across `reset`), lines and areas whose rows keep their positions, error bars, candlesticks, annotations, and heatmaps' cells. Appended and dropped rows, changed options, and changes that move a plot or the categories show at once. Box plots, boxen plots, violins, rugs, contours, dendrograms, custom marks, and layout marks other than pies and gauges refuse it.

AnnotationCoordinate.description: A place an annotation's point or span takes along an axis: a coordinate, or one on a layout item's box.

AnnotationPosition.description: A place along an axis as annotations take it: a value (a number, or a field's name), or any coordinate: `{ data }` (a category's value too), `{ field }`, `{ fraction }` of the plot, or `{ px }`, each with an offset in pixels; or an edge of a layout item's box (`{ item, at }`).

AnnotationValue.description: Where an annotation is along an axis: a number (times in epoch milliseconds), or a number or time field of the mark's table. An annotation with a field draws one item per row; with numbers only, one item.

AreaLabelsSpec.description: Labels that follow each series of an area (see `SeriesLabelsSpec`): a band's (`y1` and `y2`, or `x1` and `x2`) follow the edge `edge` names.

AreaSpec.description: Filled areas, along x or (with `orient: "y"`, or a category y) along y. Each series' values are filled to zero (or stacked on the previous series with `stack`: several value fields row by row, or the series of a `series` field on the positions any of them has). With `y1` and `y2` (along y, `x1` and `x2`), the band between two fields is filled.

dodge.title: Dodge
dodge.description: On a category position axis, with `series` and no stack: the series side by side in each band.

line.title: Line
line.description: Outline the top edge. Default true for unstacked single areas, and with `stroke`.

stroke.title: Stroke
stroke.description: Outline color; each area's own color by default.

strokeWidth.title: Stroke width
strokeWidth.description: Outline width in pixels; the theme's line width by default.

color.title: Color
color.description: The areas' fill: a category field (an area per value, unless `series` says otherwise), or a color.

encode.title: Encode
encode.description: Channels: color, fill, stroke, and opacity. One reading rows (a field other than the series', a condition) changes the area's look along its series (style runs), outside stacks.

continuity.title: Continuity
continuity.description: Which observations the areas connect (areas that do not stack).

where.title: Where
where.description: Rows the areas leave out, as gaps (areas that do not stack).

curve.title: Curve
curve.description: How the area's edges join their points (see `Curve`); "linear" by default.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: A label following each area's value edge (a band's `edge`).

selected.title: Selected
selected.description: What a selection holds of the mark (items or series selected, or the rows a row selection highlights); as drawn by default.

unselected.title: Unselected
unselected.description: What it does not, while it holds something; by default at a quarter of its opacity.

clip.title: Clip
clip.description: What the mark's drawing is cut to. Without it, data is cut to the plot, and labels, rules, and text are drawn whole (those of values outside the plot are left out).

data.title: Data
data.description: Name of the table in `ChartSpec.data`; defaults to the only table.

id.title: Id
id.description: Stable identity, used for legend state and updates.

axis.title: Axis
axis.description: The y axis the mark's values are on: "left" (the default) or "right", the chart's `yRight` axis. Category y values stay on the left.

facet.title: Facet
facet.description: With the chart's `facet`, "repeat" draws all of the mark's rows in every panel instead of splitting them by the facet field.

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: With the chart's `panels`, the id of the panel the mark draws in, or "*" for every panel.

zIndex.title: Z index
zIndex.description: Where the mark is drawn among the others of its panel: higher above lower, marks of equal `zIndex` in the order they are listed. 0 by default; grid lines are at -1. Any finite number.

pick.title: Pick
pick.description: `false`: the pointer passes through the mark to what is under it (decorations).

inspect.title: Inspect
inspect.description: `false`: tooltips, hover, and the keyboard leave the mark out.

legend.title: Legend
legend.description: `false` leaves the mark's series, color ramps, and keys out of the chart's legends.

itemKey.title: Item key
itemKey.description: A category, number, or time field whose value names each row's item. Without it, an item is its row (a bar: its position); rows sharing a value are one item, and a missing value names the row by its identity.

x.title: X
x.description: Positions along x, or with `orient: "y"` the values (one field or several, or a coordinate).

y.title: Y
y.description: Values filled to zero (one field or several, or a coordinate), or with `orient: "y"` the positions.

series.title: Series
series.description: Category field that splits rows into one area per value. Without it, a category field as `color` splits them; `false` splits by neither.

stack.title: Stack
stack.description: Pile the areas up: `true`, a mode, or its parts (`offset`, `order`, `gaps`).

y1.title: Y1
y1.description: Lower edge of a band along x.

y2.title: Y2
y2.description: Upper edge of a band along x.

x1.title: X1
x1.description: Left edge of a band along y.

x2.title: X2
x2.description: Right edge of a band along y.

AreaStack.description: Area thickness as shares, or raw values with a stream baseline.

AxisGuideSpec.description: An axis showing a position scale along a side of the plots: its ticks (the "major" layer) and more `layers`, its title, and how it looks. Unset settings take the short form's (`x`, `y`, or `yRight`).

id.title: Id
id.description: Unique among the chart's guides.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: "x", "y", "yRight", or a position scale of the chart's `scales`, which then needs `place`.

place.title: Place
place.description: Below the plots (x) or left of them (y) by default; x above, y on the right.

line.title: Line
line.description: The axis' line along the plot: x axes draw it, y axes do not, by default.

grid.title: Grid
grid.description: Grid lines at its major ticks across the plot; the scale's default axis draws them by default.

show.title: Show
show.description: Draw the axis; true by default.

repeat.title: Repeat
repeat.description: Where panels sharing the scale label it: on the outer edge of panels lined up with each other ("outer", the default), or on every panel ("all").

room.title: Room
room.description: Pixels a y axis' tick marks and labels take beside the plot: a fixed room, so that the plots of charts and panels line up, or bounds on the room its labels need. Labels wider than it are shortened with an ellipsis. Y axes only.

AxisStyles.description: The roles an axis draws: its line, ticks, tick labels, title, and grid lines.

tickLabel.title: Tick label
tickLabel.description: The labels of an axis' ticks, and the values a legend of a color ramp or a key writes.

axisLine.title: Axis line
axisLine.description: An axis' line along the plot.

AxisTitleSpec.description: An axis' title: text, or literal text and fields' labels in order.

BarLabelPlaceSpec.description: Where bars' labels go: past each bar's end (`outside`, the default for bars not stacked, just inside where past would leave the plot), or inside it at its root, middle, or tip (`attachment`: "start", "center", "end"; stacked bars' labels are inside, centered by default).

BarLabelsSpec.description: A bar's value label: the value (or with `field`, a field's), written with `format`, or `content` made of parts (each written with its own format), styled as `style` says (black or white by contrast with the bar inside it unless `style.color` is set), on bars at least `minLength` pixels long, placed as `place` says.

overlap.title: Overlap
overlap.description: Labels that would cover another of the mark's: drawn anyway ("show", the default), or left out ("hide"), the later in series and row order.

BarSpec.description: Bars. Vertical by default: a category `x` gives one band per category, a number or time `x` centers bars on its values, and `y` holds bar lengths. A category `y` (its name, or as a coordinate `{ field }`) makes them horizontal, with lengths in `x`, as `orient: "y"` does on any `y`; any other position, a frame's share or pixels included, centers vertical bars on `x`. Several length fields are drawn side by side or stacked.

halo.title: Halo
halo.description: The outline that keeps the mark's text readable over what it is drawn on: "auto" (the default), false for none, or a color of its own.

x.title: X
x.description: Positions (or lengths, for horizontal bars): fields, or as positions a coordinate.

orient.title: Orient
orient.description: The axis bars stand on: "x" (positions on x, lengths along y) or "y" (positions on y, lengths along x), whatever their fields are; without it, "y" for a category `y`, else "x".

series.title: Series
series.description: Category field that splits rows into one bar series per value. Without it, a category field as `color` splits them; `false` splits by neither, and a `color` field then colors each bar.

stack.title: Stack
stack.description: Pile series up at each position.

dodge.title: Dodge
dodge.description: Place series side by side in each position, as grouped bars: true by default for series that do not stack; false overlaps them.

stroke.title: Stroke
stroke.description: Edges: an outline of every bar.

strokeSides.title: Stroke sides
strokeSides.description: Which sides of each bar the outline draws, as they stand on screen (top, right, bottom, left; all by default), so `["top"]` caps bars whichever way their values go.

width.title: Width
width.description: Each bar's thickness across its value direction, in pixels, whatever its band's width; grouped bars stand centered in their slots.

opacity.title: Opacity
opacity.description: From 0 to 1: the bars', fill and edges.

color.title: Color
color.description: The bars' fill: a category field (a bar series per value, unless `series` says otherwise), or a color (see `encode.color`).

encode.title: Encode
encode.description: Channels per bar: color, fill, stroke, strokeWidth, and opacity.

style.title: Style
style.description: Looks by value: by series, or with `field`, by each bar's value.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Write each bar's value at its end (or, stacked, inside each segment): `true`, or how. Labels that do not fit are left out.

selected.title: Selected
selected.description: What a selection holds of the mark (items or series selected, or the rows a row selection highlights); as drawn by default.

unselected.title: Unselected
unselected.description: What it does not, while it holds something; by default at a quarter of its opacity.

clip.title: Clip
clip.description: What the mark's drawing is cut to. Without it, data is cut to the plot, and labels, rules, and text are drawn whole (those of values outside the plot are left out).

data.title: Data
data.description: Name of the table in `ChartSpec.data`; defaults to the only table.

id.title: Id
id.description: Stable identity, used for legend state and updates.

axis.title: Axis
axis.description: The y axis the mark's values are on: "left" (the default) or "right", the chart's `yRight` axis. Category y values stay on the left.

facet.title: Facet
facet.description: With the chart's `facet`, "repeat" draws all of the mark's rows in every panel instead of splitting them by the facet field.

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: With the chart's `panels`, the id of the panel the mark draws in, or "*" for every panel.

zIndex.title: Z index
zIndex.description: Where the mark is drawn among the others of its panel: higher above lower, marks of equal `zIndex` in the order they are listed. 0 by default; grid lines are at -1. Any finite number.

pick.title: Pick
pick.description: `false`: the pointer passes through the mark to what is under it (decorations).

inspect.title: Inspect
inspect.description: `false`: tooltips, hover, and the keyboard leave the mark out.

legend.title: Legend
legend.description: `false` leaves the mark's series, color ramps, and keys out of the chart's legends.

itemKey.title: Item key
itemKey.description: A category, number, or time field whose value names each row's item. Without it, an item is its row (a bar: its position); rows sharing a value are one item, and a missing value names the row by its identity.

BarStack.description: Nonnegative shares, or ordinary positive/negative stacks.

BinSpec.description: Bins along one axis, as histograms and the `bin` transform take them: about how many round bins (a count), a width and where bins start (`{ step, start }`, by default at a multiple of the step; values below an explicit start are in no bin), or the bins' edges (2 to 1,001, finite and increasing, used exactly as given). A bin holds values from its left edge up to its right one; the last holds its right edge too.

BinaryColumnSpec.description: Numbers or times (epoch milliseconds) read from a binary buffer delivered with the spec: `buffer` indexes the list of buffers that travels next to the JSON. NaN marks missing values in float columns.

BinaryFormat.description: Numbers with binary prefixes, by 1,024s from Ki to Ei, before the unit `binary`: 1572864 with `{ binary: "B" }` is "1.5 MiB"; values under 1,024 take none. The prefix is chosen after rounding.

binary.title: Binary
binary.description: The unit's symbol, written after the prefix.

decimals.title: Decimals
decimals.description: Decimals, kept when zero; by default up to 1, zeros dropped.

BinaryType.description: Element types of binary columns, stored little-endian.

BindingSpec.description: A gesture and what it does: only actions the gesture can perform.

BoxAnchor.description: A point of a box: a corner, the middle of an edge, or its center.

BoxPlotSpec.description: Box plots from raw values per category, or one precomputed box per row.

legend.title: Legend
legend.description: `false` leaves the mark's series, color ramps, and keys out of the chart's legends.

whiskers.title: Whiskers
whiskers.description: Tukey's 1.5 IQR (default), the full range, or a nonnegative IQR multiple.

notch.title: Notch
notch.description: Notch half-width: 1.57 IQR / sqrt(count). Raw boxes use their finite observation count; precomputed boxes require a count field.

outliers.title: Outliers
outliers.description: Dots at the values beyond the whiskers; true by default. Hidden ones are still counted in tooltips, and leave the value axis' extent.

series.title: Series
series.description: Category field: a box per value in each category, side by side.

color.title: Color
color.description: A category field naming the series, whose values color them (as `series` does, which must then name it too), or a color for every shape, as `fill` sets it.

fill.title: Fill
fill.description: Constant color for every shape; colors come from the palette otherwise.

fillOpacity.title: Fill opacity
fillOpacity.description: Opacity of the boxes' fill; 0.25 by default.

BoxenSpec.description: Letter-value ("boxen") plots: per category, nested boxes between a number field's letter values (its quartiles, eighths, sixteenths, ...) out from the median, each level narrower and lighter than the one inside it, as Seaborn's `boxenplot` and Hofmann, Wickham, and Kafadar's letter-value plots draw them, with the values beyond the outermost box as dots. One of `x` and `y` is a category field, the other the values.

series.title: Series
series.description: Category field: a box per value in each category, side by side.

color.title: Color
color.description: A category field naming the series, whose values color them (as `series` does, which must then name it too), or a color for every shape, as `fill` sets it.

depth.title: Depth
depth.description: How many letter values each side (levels of boxes) a group draws: "tukey" (the default) leaves 5 to 8 values in each tail, "proportion" about `outlierProportion` of them, "trustworthy" stops where a letter value's confidence interval at `trustAlpha` would overlap the next one's, "full" reaches every value; or a whole number of levels from 1, the box of the quartiles.

outlierProportion.title: Outlier proportion
outlierProportion.description: The share of values left beyond the boxes with `depth: "proportion"`; 0.007 by default.

trustAlpha.title: Trust alpha
trustAlpha.description: The significance level `depth: "trustworthy"` stops at; 0.05 by default.

widthMethod.title: Width method
widthMethod.description: How a level's width shrinks from the quartile box's: by half each level ("exponential", the default), by the same step each level ("linear"), or so that each box's area is proportional to the share of values it holds ("area").

outliers.title: Outliers
outliers.description: Dots at the values beyond the outermost boxes; true by default.

fill.title: Fill
fill.description: Constant color for every shape; colors come from the palette otherwise.

fillOpacity.title: Fill opacity
fillOpacity.description: Opacity of the quartile box's fill, which outer levels lighten; 0.7 by default.

BrushAction.description: Selects what a drag covers along x or y, a rectangle, or a lasso; with `zoom`, zooms to its ranges on release instead (a lasso still selects). Brushes that select rows for `rowSelection` never zoom.

edit.title: Edit
edit.description: Dragging inside the brush moves it, its edges and corners resize it, and the wheel over it resizes it about the pointer (elsewhere the wheel does what it did); not for lassos. These are bindings: `editBrush`.

clear.title: Clear
clear.description: What clears it: a click off it (the default), a double click (`clearBrush` bound to it), or neither (`false`); Escape always does.

BrushSelection.description: What a brush selected, or `select` set as if brushed: ranges along x and y in data values (epoch ms on time axes, band indices on category axes), and a lasso's outline.

x.title: X
x.description: The x range, ascending; null for brushes along y.

y.title: Y
y.description: The y range, ascending; null for brushes along x.

lasso.title: Lasso
lasso.description: A lasso's outline as x, y pairs; null for other brushes, whose ranges say it all.

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: The panel it was drawn in, where that panel's scales are not every panel's.

CalendarBreak.description: A calendar unit lines break at the boundaries of, in the chart's time zone.

CameraSpec.description: The view of a 3D chart: the eye's direction from the box's center, and how the box is drawn. Angles are in degrees.

azimuth.title: Azimuth
azimuth.description: About the vertical z axis, counterclockwise from +x seen from above; -60 by default.

elevation.title: Elevation
elevation.description: Above the x-y plane, from -90 (from below) to 90 (from above); 25 by default.

zoom.title: Zoom
zoom.description: Magnification from 0.5 to 10; 1, the default, fits the box in the chart.

perspective.title: Perspective
perspective.description: Perspective, nearer things larger, rather than orthographic projection (the default).

CandlestickSpec.description: Candles at each `x` from open to close, with wicks from low to high. Candles that close at or above their open are drawn hollow in the rise color, others filled in the fall color, so direction never rests on color alone.

variant.title: Variant
variant.description: "candlestick" (the default): bodies from open to close. "ohlc": bars, a line from low to high with the open ticked to its left and the close to its right.

rise.title: Rise
rise.description: Color of candles closing at or above their open; the theme's `rise` by default.

fall.title: Fall
fall.description: Color of candles closing below their open; the theme's `fall` by default.

selected.title: Selected
selected.description: What a selection holds of the mark (items or series selected, or the rows a row selection highlights); as drawn by default.

unselected.title: Unselected
unselected.description: What it does not, while it holds something; by default at a quarter of its opacity.

clip.title: Clip
clip.description: What the mark's drawing is cut to. Without it, data is cut to the plot, and labels, rules, and text are drawn whole (those of values outside the plot are left out).

data.title: Data
data.description: Name of the table in `ChartSpec.data`; defaults to the only table.

id.title: Id
id.description: Stable identity, used for legend state and updates.

axis.title: Axis
axis.description: The y axis the mark's values are on: "left" (the default) or "right", the chart's `yRight` axis. Category y values stay on the left.

facet.title: Facet
facet.description: With the chart's `facet`, "repeat" draws all of the mark's rows in every panel instead of splitting them by the facet field.

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: With the chart's `panels`, the id of the panel the mark draws in, or "*" for every panel.

zIndex.title: Z index
zIndex.description: Where the mark is drawn among the others of its panel: higher above lower, marks of equal `zIndex` in the order they are listed. 0 by default; grid lines are at -1. Any finite number.

pick.title: Pick
pick.description: `false`: the pointer passes through the mark to what is under it (decorations).

inspect.title: Inspect
inspect.description: `false`: tooltips, hover, and the keyboard leave the mark out.

legend.title: Legend
legend.description: `false` leaves the mark's series, color ramps, and keys out of the chart's legends.

itemKey.title: Item key
itemKey.description: A category, number, or time field whose value names each row's item. Without it, an item is its row (a bar: its position); rows sharing a value are one item, and a missing value names the row by its identity.

CategoryColumnSpec.description: Dictionary-encoded categories: int32 codes into `dictionary`, -1 for missing values. `codes` is a buffer index or an inline JSON array.

CellReduce.description: How rows sharing a heatmap's cell combine into its value.

ChannelScaleSpec.description: A continuous scale for channels other than position, in the chart's `scales`: it maps a number field's values onto widths, opacities, sizes (areas), or colors. Its domain is the fields' extent over the rows the marks reading it draw, unless given; `range` is its outputs at the domain's ends: two numbers, or two or more colors ("#rrggbb", a ramp through them, evenly spaced). Inputs past the domain extend it, or with `clamp` take its ends' outputs; colors stay at their ends. Outputs stay in what the channel takes (opacities from 0 to 1, widths and sizes from 0). Missing values, and values the scale cannot take (a log's zero or less, a square root's negatives), take the mark's own paint; points, which leave out rows missing a value they encode, leave those out.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: The inputs mapped to `range`'s ends: two different numbers, positive for "log", not negative for "sqrt".

ChannelSpec<Dash>.description: A value per row: a field's value read through a scale (the channel's default scale, "color" for colors, the one of the chart's `scales` that `scale` names: of categories for a category field, a channel scale for a number field; or with `scale: { type: "identity" }` the value itself), the series' names through a scale (`{ series: true, scale }`: series of marks naming one scale share colors, legend entries, and dodged places by name, as a line and the band around it do), a constant, or a condition: `then` where `when` (an expression over the row, or a rank test) holds, `otherwise` elsewhere, and without `otherwise` no output there (the next channel of a list, else the mark's fallback, as for a value a scale does not map).

ChannelsSpec<Dash>.description: A channel, or channels tried in order: the first that gives a drawn item (a row, or in a mark of several y fields a row of one series) an output wins. A missing value, a value a scale does not map, and a failing condition without `otherwise` give none; "transparent", 0, and a dash are outputs. An entry after one that always gives an output (a constant, the series' names, a condition with `otherwise`) is refused. A list splits no series: a mark keeping its series names them (`series`).

ChartAxisSpec.description: One of the chart's position scales (x, y, or yRight) and its axis: the scale's settings, the axis', and which panels share the scale.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Which panels share one instance of the scale: in facets, the whole chart by default for x and y; in subplots, each panel; for yRight, as y. Only charts with facets or panels have several.

repeat.title: Repeat
repeat.description: Where panels sharing the scale label it: "outer" (the default) only on the outer edge of panels lined up on the same rows or columns, below the lowest and beside the first (on the right, the last); "all" on every panel.

type.title: Type
type.description: Inferred from the data when omitted: time fields get "time".

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: Fixed domain. Time domains are epoch milliseconds.

nice.title: Nice
nice.description: Extend the domain to round tick values. Default true for y, and for x when it measures horizontal bars.

zero.title: Zero
zero.description: Include zero in the domain. Default true for the value axis of areas and bars.

padding.title: Padding
padding.description: Room between the data and the plot's edges: "auto" by default (see `ScalePadding`).

title.title: Title
title.description: Axis title: text, or text and fields' labels (`[{ label: "p99" }]`).

grid.title: Grid
grid.description: Grid lines across the plot, and where they are drawn among the marks (`{ zIndex }`). Default true for y, and for x when it measures horizontal bars.

ticks.title: Ticks
ticks.description: Which ticks it draws: about how many (a number), one `every` so often, or exactly `values`.

format.title: Format
format.description: How tick labels are written: Intl options, or a pattern (`{ number: ",.2f" }`, `{ time: "%H:%M" }`).

tooltipFormat.title: Tooltip format
tooltipFormat.description: How tooltips, the keyboard's announcements, and crosshair labels write one value of the axis, such as `{ weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric" }` or `{ time: "%a %H:%M" }`, leaving tick labels as they are: as `format` takes them; `format` by default.

style.title: Style
style.description: How the axis' parts look: its line, ticks, tick labels, title, and grid lines.

ChartSelection.description: A chart's selection: one at a time, of a brush, of items, or of series; each replaces the others.

ChartSpec.description: A chart's options; its state options (`selection`, `viewport`, `visibility`, `drillRoot`; see `StateSpec`) give its first state, which static exports draw.

version.title: Version
version.description: Spec format version; 1, the only one so far, when omitted.

title.title: Title
title.description: The chart's title, also its accessible name: its text, or its text with where it goes (above the chart, the default, or below) and how it looks.

width.title: Width
width.description: CSS pixels. In the browser, omitted sizes follow the container.

data.title: Data
data.description: Tables referenced by marks, by name.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: How fields are named and their values written, by field name or as rules applied in order (see `FieldDisplaysSpec`): axes, legends, series' names, tooltips, labels, gauges, and the text alternative write fields through them (docs/guide/fields.md).

x.title: X
x.description: The x scale and its axis: the short form of the scale named "x" and the axis guide that shows it.

y.title: Y
y.description: The left y scale ("y") and its axis.

yRight.title: Y right
yRight.description: A second y axis on the right ("yRight"), for marks with `axis: "right"`, with its own scale and domain; in charts with facets or panels, in every panel drawing such marks. Grid lines follow it only where no mark uses the left axis.

scales.title: Scales
scales.description: The position scales' settings by name ("x", "y", "yRight"), over the short forms' scale settings (type, domain, nice, zero, scope).

guides.title: Guides
guides.description: Axes, legends, and colorbars: an axis listed for a scale replaces the scale's automatic one (its unset settings taken from the short form), a legend or colorbar lists the scales it shows in place of the automatic legend's.

facet.title: Facet
facet.description: Small multiples: the chart drawn once per value of a category field.

panels.title: Panels
panels.description: Subplots: panels, each drawing the marks that name it in their `panel`, with scales of their own unless a scale's `scope` shares them. Not with `facet`.

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: Where `panels` go: a grid of rows and columns whose cells hold panels or grids, and insets over panels. One column of the panels, in order, by default.

legend.title: Legend
legend.description: The series legend: shown when the chart has several series unless `false`; `true` or an object shows it also for one, with an object saying where it goes (above the plots by default) and how it looks.

padding.title: Padding
padding.description: Whitespace between the chart's edges and everything it draws, in pixels: the same on every side, or each side's own. Room guides need (labels reaching past a plot's ends) comes on top. Sides left out keep the automatic spacing: a few pixels, more where text tends to reach.

inspection.title: Inspection
inspection.description: How the pointer, the keyboard, and cursors other charts share find the data the tooltip, hover and click events, and announcements read (see `InspectionSpec`); `false` has the pointer read nothing, while the keyboard still reads and announces points.

tooltip.title: Tooltip
tooltip.description: The tooltip box: `false` hides it (inspection goes on, for hover listeners).

rowSelection.title: Row selection
rowSelection.description: Binds the chart to a channel of a table's selection store, one binding per table: brushes, lassos, and clicks write the rows they select there, and the chart highlights the rows the channel holds, whoever selected them (another chart, a grid). Stores are not part of the spec: `loadSpec` takes them, or makes them. Needs marks along axes.

navigator.title: Navigator
navigator.description: A range navigator: a strip under the plot drawing the chart's marks over the whole x domain, with a window showing the x range in view, which dragging and the keyboard move and resize. `true` uses the defaults. Needs a number or time x axis; with facets or panels, one strip goes under all of them and moves the x range they share, so `x.scope` must be "chart".

animation.title: Animation
animation.description: Moves the axes (or a map's or network's plane) gradually to a view asked for: `setViewport`, zooming to a brush, and double-click reset; with `values`, marks (and the axes with them) to changed values too, in every panel. Off by default; `true` takes 250 ms. Never for wheel zoom, panning, drilling, streaming, linked charts, views of several panels, or slow frames, nor where the page prefers reduced motion.

renderer.title: Renderer
renderer.description: Renderer for marks: "auto" (the default) draws them in SVG, and in Canvas while the chart draws many points; "svg" or "canvas" always.

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: BCP 47 locale for labels; defaults to the runtime locale.

timeZone.title: Time zone
timeZone.description: "local" (default), "UTC", or an IANA zone for time axes and labels.

projection.title: Projection
projection.description: How maps (`geoshape` and `geopoint` marks) are projected: a projection's name, or one with parameters. Equal Earth by default.

z.title: Z
z.description: The vertical axis of 3D charts (`point3d`, `line3d`, and `surface` marks), whose `x` and `y` are the floor's. Only for 3D charts.

type.title: Type
type.description: Inferred from the data when omitted: time fields get "time".

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: Fixed domain. Time domains are epoch milliseconds.

nice.title: Nice
nice.description: Extend the domain to round tick values. Default true for y, and for x when it measures horizontal bars.

zero.title: Zero
zero.description: Include zero in the domain. Default true for the value axis of areas and bars.

padding.title: Padding
padding.description: Room between the data and the plot's edges: "auto" by default (see `ScalePadding`).

grid.title: Grid
grid.description: Grid lines across the plot, and where they are drawn among the marks (`{ zIndex }`). Default true for y, and for x when it measures horizontal bars.

ticks.title: Ticks
ticks.description: Which ticks it draws: about how many (a number), one `every` so often, or exactly `values`.

format.title: Format
format.description: How tick labels are written: Intl options, or a pattern (`{ number: ",.2f" }`, `{ time: "%H:%M" }`).

tooltipFormat.title: Tooltip format
tooltipFormat.description: How tooltips, the keyboard's announcements, and crosshair labels write one value of the axis, such as `{ weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric" }` or `{ time: "%a %H:%M" }`, leaving tick labels as they are: as `format` takes them; `format` by default.

camera.title: Camera
camera.description: Where a 3D chart is seen from at first; the pointer and keyboard turn it. Only for 3D charts.

boxAspect.title: Box aspect
boxAspect.description: The relative lengths of a 3D chart's x, y, and z sides: [1, 1, 1], a cube, by default. Only for 3D charts.

ClearBrushAction.description: The brush clears, where the chart has one; elsewhere, later bindings are tried.

Clip.description: What a mark's drawing is cut to: its plot, the whole chart, or nothing (`false`), which lets markers at a plot's edge show whole. Turning the plot's clip off does not grow the chart: a chart's outputs still end at its size.

ColorbarSpec.description: A continuous color scale's legend: a bar of its colors along its values, with ticks as an axis has them. Beside the plots it stands vertically, low values at the bottom; above or below them, across, low values at the left.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: The scale it shows; the chart's only color ramp when left out.

place.title: Place
place.description: On the right of the plots by default.

layers.title: Layers
layers.description: More layers of ticks along the bar, as axes take them.

length.title: Length
length.description: Pixels along its values; the plots' height (or width) by default, up to 240.

tickLabel.title: Tick label
tickLabel.description: The labels of an axis' ticks, and the values a legend of a color ramp or a key writes.

legendTitle.title: Legend title
legendTitle.description: The titles of a legend's color ramps and keys.

ColumnSpec.description: Column values: a JSON array (numbers with null for missing values, or strings for categories), a time column, or a binary column.

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: The table these rows were made from, by a computation outside the spec (statistics, a model's fit): the fields both tables have stand for the same things, so their values take one color and one legend entry in both, as a derived table's do (see `DerivedSpec`).

matrix.title: Matrix
matrix.description: The table is a matrix (`fromMatrix`): the columns `x` and `y` name hold its coordinates, one value per column of the matrix and one per row, and every other column a value at each pair, in rows of x (the i-th x and j-th y at j × number of x values + i).

orderBy.title: Order by
orderBy.description: A number or time field the rows are kept in ascending order of, ties in the order they arrived (`orderedTable`): rows appended later merge into place. Every row needs a value of it.

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Keep at most this many rows: appends drop the first. A whole number of at least 1.

ContinuitySpec.description: Which neighboring observations a line or area connects, decided before it is drawn or reduced: never across a missing value, a row `defined` rejects, more than `maxGap` along its positions (in their units; for times, milliseconds or `{ milliseconds }`), or a boundary `breakBy` names (a calendar unit, or a change of a field's value).

ContourSpec.description: Contours of a field sampled on a grid: each row the field's `color` at an `x` and a `y` of a rectilinear grid (the distinct x values crossed with the distinct y values; a matrix table holds one as it is), with lines where the field crosses each threshold, or bands filled from one threshold up to the next. Values are interpolated linearly between grid points; points without a value leave holes. Contours end where the grid does.

x.title: X
x.description: Number or time field: each grid point's x.

y.title: Y
y.description: Number or time field: each grid point's y.

color.title: Color
color.description: Number field: the field's value at each grid point.

thresholds.title: Thresholds
thresholds.description: About how many round thresholds across the field's values (10 by default; for bands, round edges covering them), or the thresholds, finite and increasing (for bands, at least two).

variant.title: Variant
variant.description: "lines" (the default) at each threshold, or "bands" filled between neighboring ones.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: Color ramp from low to high values, or a scheme name; the theme's by default.

colorDomain.title: Color domain
colorDomain.description: The values at the ends of the ramp; the field's extent by default.

colorMidpoint.title: Color midpoint
colorMidpoint.description: The value at the ramp's middle, for diverging schemes.

stroke.title: Stroke
stroke.description: One color for every line, instead of its value's on the ramp. Lines only.

strokeWidth.title: Stroke width
strokeWidth.description: Line width in pixels; the theme's by default. Lines only.

fillOpacity.title: Fill opacity
fillOpacity.description: Opacity of the bands' fill; 1 by default. Bands only.

label.title: Label
label.description: What the field is, in the legend and tooltips; the `color` field's name by default.

clip.title: Clip
clip.description: What the mark's drawing is cut to. Without it, data is cut to the plot, and labels, rules, and text are drawn whole (those of values outside the plot are left out).

data.title: Data
data.description: Name of the table in `ChartSpec.data`; defaults to the only table.

id.title: Id
id.description: Stable identity, used for legend state and updates.

facet.title: Facet
facet.description: With the chart's `facet`, "repeat" draws all of the mark's rows in every panel instead of splitting them by the facet field.

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: With the chart's `panels`, the id of the panel the mark draws in, or "*" for every panel.

zIndex.title: Z index
zIndex.description: Where the mark is drawn among the others of its panel: higher above lower, marks of equal `zIndex` in the order they are listed. 0 by default; grid lines are at -1. Any finite number.

pick.title: Pick
pick.description: `false`: the pointer passes through the mark to what is under it (decorations).

inspect.title: Inspect
inspect.description: `false`: tooltips, hover, and the keyboard leave the mark out.

legend.title: Legend
legend.description: `false` leaves the mark's series, color ramps, and keys out of the chart's legends.

Coordinate.description: A place along one axis. `data` is a value on a scale (a number, a time in epoch milliseconds, or a category's value); `field` reads each row's value; `fraction` is a share of a frame, 0 at its left or bottom and 1 at its right or top, as in plots; `px` counts pixels from a frame's left or top edge, down for y, as on screens. A fraction or pixel count may be each row's value of a number field (`{ fraction: { field } }`), and shares outside 0 to 1 are places beyond the frame, which clipping decides about. `scale` names the scale of `data` and `field`: "x", "y", "yRight", or a position scale of the chart's `scales` with no axis of its own (by default the axis' own). `frame` is the box of `fraction` and `px` ("plot" by default). `offset` moves the result by that many pixels, right for x and down for y. Only `data` and `field` count toward a scale's domain.

CursorAction.description: The cursor follows a drag, which pans nothing (as a touch scrubs along a line).

CursorShowSpec.description: How a chart shows a cursor that is not its own pointer's: which points, and whether with its tooltip.

snap.title: Snap
snap.description: Which point of each series it reads (see `Snap`); by default, as the chart's `inspection` reads.

tooltip.title: Tooltip
tooltip.description: The chart's tooltip shows at the cursor too; off by default.

CursorSyncSpec.description: The cursor's channel, and how the chart shows the cursors it receives (one tooltip at most).

snap.title: Snap
snap.description: Which point of each series it reads (see `Snap`); by default, as the chart's `inspection` reads.

tooltip.title: Tooltip
tooltip.description: The chart's tooltip shows at the cursor too; off by default.

Curve.description: How a line joins its points: straight, in steps, or "monotone", a smooth curve through every point that never passes a point's value between two points.

Dash.description: Pixel dash array, or a matplotlib style scaled by the resolved stroke width.

DataSpec.description: A table: its columns, rows derived from another table of the spec, or a view of another's rows.

DendrogramSpec.description: A SciPy-layout linkage tree, whose leaves stand on category bands.

leaves.title: Leaves
leaves.description: Category labels indexed by leaf id; exactly one more than the merge rows.

side.title: Side
side.description: Plot edge at height zero; default bottom. Heights are values on the other axis, whose automatic domain descends for top and right.

clip.title: Clip
clip.description: What the mark's drawing is cut to. Without it, data is cut to the plot, and labels, rules, and text are drawn whole (those of values outside the plot are left out).

data.title: Data
data.description: Name of the table in `ChartSpec.data`; defaults to the only table.

id.title: Id
id.description: Stable identity, used for legend state and updates.

facet.description: With the chart's `facet`, "repeat" draws all of the mark's rows in every panel instead of splitting them by the facet field.

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: With the chart's `panels`, the id of the panel the mark draws in, or "*" for every panel.

zIndex.title: Z index
zIndex.description: Where the mark is drawn among the others of its panel: higher above lower, marks of equal `zIndex` in the order they are listed. 0 by default; grid lines are at -1. Any finite number.

pick.title: Pick
pick.description: `false`: the pointer passes through the mark to what is under it (decorations).

inspect.title: Inspect
inspect.description: `false`: tooltips, hover, and the keyboard leave the mark out.

DerivedSpec.description: Rows computed from the table `source` by `transform`, in order. Charts built from the spec keep it current as the source changes.

DisplayedKind.description: A kind of field displays write: numbers, times, or categories.

DoubleClickGesture.description: A double click on the plot.

DragGesture.description: A press that moves: by a mouse button (0, the primary, by default) or a touch or pen.

pointer.title: Pointer
pointer.description: Only presses of this kind; any by default.

DrillState.description: A tree's drill root: its item key or its names from the top; null for the whole tree.

DurationFormat.description: Numbers as lengths of time, in their largest units: 66000 milliseconds is "1m 6s", 450 is "450ms". Unit symbols are d, h, m, s, ms, µs, and ns; digits are the locale's.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: The unit the values are in.

maxUnits.title: Max units
maxUnits.description: At most this many units, the largest first ("1m 6s" is two).

decimals.title: Decimals
decimals.description: Decimals of the last unit, kept when zero.

DurationUnit.description: A unit lengths of time are in. Weeks and longer have no fixed length.

EditBrushAction.description: The brush moves with a drag that starts inside it, and resizes with one that starts on its edges or corners; the wheel over it resizes it about the pointer. Elsewhere, later bindings are tried.

ErrorBarSpec.description: Error bars: vertical intervals at each `x`, from `y1` to `y2` or from `y - yError` to `y + yError`; or horizontal intervals at each `y`, from `x1` to `x2` or `x ± xError`. Positions may be category, number, or time fields; ends, centers, and errors are number or time fields. Positions and ends may be coordinates; a center and its error are fields, in the same units.

color.title: Color
color.description: A category field naming the series, whose values color them (as `series` does, which must then name it too), or a color for every mark's lines, as `stroke` sets it.

dodge.title: Dodge
dodge.description: With `series` and category positions, the series side by side in each band, as grouped bars are, so each interval stands on its bar.

cap.title: Cap
cap.description: Width of the caps at each end in pixels; 0 for none. Default 8.

panel.title: Panel

pick.title: Pick

inspect.title: Inspect

legend.title: Legend
legend.description: `false` leaves the mark's series, color ramps, and keys out of the chart's legends.

itemKey.title: Item key
itemKey.description: A category, number, or time field whose value names each row's item. Without it, an item is its row (a bar: its position); rows sharing a value are one item, and a missing value names the row by its identity.

Expression.description: A literal, or an operator applied to expressions.

FacetSpec.description: Panels by the values of category fields, in order of first appearance, sharing their x and y scales: one field's values wrapped into rows of panels, or a grid with a row per value of `row` and a column per value of `column` (either may be left out). Every mark over a table splits its rows by the fields unless it has `facet: "repeat"`; marks without a table repeat.

FieldDisplay.description: How a field of any kind is named and its values written and colored. Each kind takes what it writes: numbers a number format, bounds, thresholds, and mappings by value or range; times a time format and mappings by value or range; categories mappings by value or regular expression.

format.title: Format
format.description: How values are written: number forms for numbers, time forms for times.

min.title: Min
min.description: The field's lower bound (numbers): never an axis' domain.

thresholds.title: Thresholds
thresholds.description: Colors of its values by step (numbers).

link.title: Link

label.title: Label

missing.title: Missing
missing.description: How missing values show: their text ("–" by default), or their text and color.

FieldDisplaysSpec.description: Field displays: by field name, or rules applied in order, a later rule's settings over an earlier one's, setting by setting (`false` resets one). A surface's own option (an axis' `format`) wins over both, for it alone.

FieldLink.description: A link from each value: a URL, constant or made of parts, and its text. URL parts write values raw and URL-encoded (numbers as digits, times as epoch milliseconds, categories as they are); a row missing a value they read has no link. Text parts write values through their displays; the value's own text by default. Only http, https, mailto, and relative URLs are links: others are written as text.

FieldMatchSpec.description: Which fields a rule applies to: one by name, or every field that all the given keys hold for: named (`field`), whose name matches `regex` (a JavaScript regular expression, unanchored), of a kind, or of a table the spec's `data` names, and the same fields of tables derived from it that pass them through unchanged.

FieldRuleSpec.description: A display and the fields it applies to; every field without `match`.

FiscalSpec.description: A fiscal year: it starts on the first of month `start` (1 to 12) and is named by the year it ends in ("end", the default) or starts in. Time patterns write it with %Y, %y, and %q (its quarter); month and year ticks step from its start.

FormatSpec.description: How values are written: numbers as `NumberFormatSpec` says (Intl options, a d3-format pattern such as ",.2f" or ".1%", a duration, or a unit with SI or binary prefixes), times as `TimeFormatSpec` says (Intl date options, or a strftime pattern such as "%b %d %H:%M"). The forms are told apart by their keys (`number`, `time`, `duration`, `si`, `binary`); a format gives one of them, or Intl options.

Frame.description: The boxes `fraction` and `px` coordinates are measured in: a panel's plot, or the whole chart.

FrameCoordinate.description: A constant share of a frame or pixels from its edge: where furniture such as an inset is placed.

FunnelSpec.description: A funnel: a centered bar per category, top to bottom, its width in proportion to the sum of `value` over the category's rows (or their count), with faint connectors between neighboring bars.

halo.title: Halo
halo.description: The outline that keeps the mark's text readable over what it is drawn on: "auto" (the default), false for none, or a color of its own.

category.title: Category
category.description: Category field: a stage per value.

value.title: Value
value.description: Number field summed per stage; without it, stages count rows.

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: "input" (the default) keeps the categories' order; "value" puts the largest stage first.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Stage names beside the bars and values on them; true by default.

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: With the chart's `panels`, the id of the panel the funnel has to itself.

GaugeBand.description: A colored range of a gauge's dial: from the previous band's end, or `min`, up to `to`.

color.title: Color
color.description: The band's color; the theme's palette, in order, by default.

GaugeSpec.description: A gauge: the last finite value of a number field on a dial from `min` to `max`, so appending rows moves it. The dial is a 240-degree arc open at the bottom; bands color ranges of it.

value.title: Value
value.description: Number field whose last finite value the gauge shows.

min.title: Min
min.description: The ends of the dial; 0 and 100 by default.

bands.title: Bands
bands.description: Colored ranges, by ascending ends above `min` and at most `max`.

label.title: Label
label.description: Text under the value; the field's name by default.

format.title: Format
format.description: How the value and the dial's ends are written, in any of numbers' forms.

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: With the chart's `panels`, the id of the panel the gauge has to itself.

labelField.title: Label field
labelField.description: Category field naming each point, for tooltips, keyboard reading, and the summary.

series.title: Series
series.description: A category field: a series per value; by default a category `color` field, and `false` for none.

color.title: Color
color.description: A number field colored on a continuous scale.

fillOpacity.title: Fill opacity

stroke.title: Stroke

geometry.title: Geometry
geometry.description: The geometry field; the table's only one by default.

labelField.title: Label field

colors.title: Colors

GeometryColumnSpec.description: Polygons and multipolygons in longitude and latitude (degrees, WGS 84), packed as GeoArrow nests multipolygons. Each array is a buffer index or an inline JSON array: `coordinates` float64 longitude, latitude pairs; `ringOffsets` int32 offsets into coordinate pairs; `polygonOffsets` int32 offsets into rings (each polygon's exterior first, then its holes); and `geometryOffsets` int32 offsets into polygons, each array one longer than the things it divides. Row i holds geometry `codes[i]` (int32, -1 for none), or geometry i without `codes`. Edges are straight in longitude and latitude, as GeoJSON defines them.

GraphLayout.description:
How a network's nodes are placed: a name, or an object naming it in `type` with its options.
- "force" (the default): a force simulation; `settle` (true by default) lets the nodes near a node moved by hand settle around it.
- "circular": one circle, by group (in legend order), then by `sort`: "degree" (the default, most connected first), "input" (the nodes' order in the data), or "name"; ties by name.
- "layered": layers in the links' direction, from source to target, for trees and directed acyclic networks: `direction` "down" (the default), "right", "up", or "left". Links closing cycles run against it.

GraphSpec.description: A network of nodes joined by links, from a table with a row per link. Nodes are the names in `source` and `target` and, with `nodes`, the rows of a table of nodes; links are undirected, as thick as the sum of `value` over their rows when there is one. Rows without a positive, finite value and links from a node to itself are left out. A network draws at most 50,000 nodes and 200,000 links.

source.title: Source
source.description: Category field naming one end of each row's link.

target.title: Target
target.description: Category field naming the other end; a name in both fields is one node.

value.title: Value
value.description: Number field summed per pair of nodes, setting links' widths; without it, links are alike.

directed.title: Directed
directed.description: Links go from `source` to `target`, with an arrowhead at the target; a pair's links one way and the other are two.

linkLabelField.title: Link label field
linkLabelField.description: Category field naming each link, written along those with room; a link of rows naming it differently has none.

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.description: Name of a table in `ChartSpec.data` with a row per node; needs `node`.

node.title: Node
node.description: Category field of `nodes` naming each row's node, as `source` and `target` do.

color.title: Color

size.title: Size

labels.title: Labels

layout.title: Layout

panel.title: Panel

header.title: Header

gap.title: Gap

GridLayoutSpec.description: Rows and columns of tracks, and the cells placed on them. Cells hold a panel or another grid; a cell may span several tracks, may not overlap another, and tracks may have no cell. Without `cells`, the chart's panels not placed elsewhere fill the grid row by row, in order, with as many rows (of weight 1) as they need.

rows.title: Rows

columns.title: Columns

gap.title: Gap

Halo.description: An outline drawn around text to keep it readable over lines and fills: "auto" (the default for text over data) is the color of the surface under the text, whatever the text's own color (under a transparent background, black behind light text and white behind dark, as the page likely is); `false` draws none; or a color of its own, 3 pixels wide by default.

"weeks" (the default) puts a column per week along a time x axis and a row per day of the week, from `weekStart` ("mon" by default) down; "months" a row per month, from the first day's month down, and a column per day of the month, 1 to 31.
