Its values make no legend entries and split no series.

InsetAnchor.description: The corner or middle of an inset placed at a position.

InsetIndicatorSpec.description: How an inset's indicator looks: its box's line and whether lines join it to the inset.

connectors.title: Connectors
connectors.description: Lines from the box to the inset's nearest corners; true by default.

InsetPlace.description: Where an inset goes on its parent's plot: at a corner or the middle of an edge, `inset` pixels in (8 by default); or with its `anchor` (its top-left corner by default) at a position given as fractions of the parent's plot or of the chart, or pixels.

InsetPosition.description: Where an inset's anchor goes: fractions of the parent's plot or the chart, or pixels, not data.

InsetSize.description: A length of an inset: a fraction of its parent's plot, or pixels.

InsetSpec.description: A panel drawn over its parent's plot, its axes inside its own box (and its titles, but for what of a long one runs past it), with scales of its own unless a scope names it (insets are not part of a scale's "chart" scope). It takes no room from the layout and does not widen its parent's domains.

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: The id of one of the chart's panels, placed nowhere else.

place.title: Place
place.description: At the parent plot's top right, 8 pixels in, by default.

width.title: Width
width.description: 35% of the parent's plot by default.

indicator.title: Indicator
indicator.description: A box on the parent's plot around the inset's x and y ranges, with lines to the inset's corners: `true`, or how it looks. Needs number or time axes of the same kind in both.

insets.title: Insets
insets.description: Panels drawn over this inset's plot.

Insets.description: Space around or inside a box, in CSS pixels: the same on every side, or each side's own.

Inside.description: A corner or the middle of an edge of a plot or of the chart, inside it.

InsidePlace.description: Inside a plot, over what it draws, taking no room from it: at a corner or the middle of an edge, `inset` pixels in (8 by default). With `scope: "panel"` (the default) inside the plot of panel `panel` (the first one by default); with `scope: "chart"`, inside the area every panel shares.

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: With `scope: "panel"`, the key of the panel (a subplot's id, a facet's value).

InspectionSpec.description: How inspection reads the data at the pointer or the keyboard's cursor. Along an axis ("nearest-x", "nearest-y"), `snap` says which point of each series is read and `within` how far along the axis from the pointer's value it may be: a number in the axis' units, or `{ milliseconds }` on a time axis. "nearest" reads the one point nearest the pointer on screen, within `{ px }`. Without `mode`, the marks choose: "nearest-y" for marks along y (horizontal bars), "nearest" for points, else "nearest-x"; a `within` names its mode, whose units it is in. Panels of cells only (heatmaps) read the cell under the pointer whatever the mode.

InteractionSpec.description: How the chart answers the pointer, the wheel, touch, and keys. `pan`, `zoom`, `brush`, `rotate`, and `drag` are presets: each stands for the bindings it lists (see docs), which `bindings` comes before. Defaults suit pages that scroll: the vertical wheel scrolls the page, and the wheel zooms only with Ctrl or ⌘ held (as trackpads pinch).

pan.title: Pan
pan.description: Dragging pans these axes (`true` is x; a map's or network's plane, both ways), the horizontal wheel (and Shift with the wheel) pans x, and double-click resets. Category axes do not pan. `zoom` pans as well, unless `pan` is false.

zoom.title: Zoom
zoom.description: Zooms these axes: the wheel with Ctrl or ⌘ held, a trackpad or touch pinch, and the + and − keys zoom, 0 and double-click reset, and dragging pans unless `pan` is false. `true` is x (category axes do not zoom); maps and networks zoom both ways (`true` or "xy"), 3D charts magnify their camera, and treemaps and sunbursts drill into nodes on a click (`true`).

brush.title: Brush
brush.description: Drag to select: a range along x or y, a rectangle ("xy"), or a freehand region ("lasso"), reported as `select` events while it is drawn and when released; a click clears it. With `zoom` on along the brush's axes, a brush zooms to what it covers instead (Shift-drag pans); lassos only select. Maps and networks take "lasso". With its settings, a brush that can be moved and resized, and cleared otherwise (see `BrushOptions`).

select.title: Select
select.description: What a click or Enter selects (see `ChartSelection`): the item picked ("items"), or its series ("series"); nothing by default (`false`). Shift with a click adds or removes it; a click on the one selected, or off the data, clears.

bindings.title: Bindings
bindings.description: Gestures bound to actions, matched in order before the presets' bindings: the first whose gesture matches the input, and whose action applies where it happens, takes it. A gesture may be bound once.

limits.title: Limits
limits.description: How far the view may go, and when it nears its ends, per scale ("x", "y", "yRight").

sync.title: Sync
sync.description: Shares the cursor, the view, and the selection with the charts of the same group: a group's name for all three along x, or each channel's group (and scale) on its own; channels left out are not shared.

rotate.title: Rotate
rotate.description: Dragging turns 3D charts; true by default. Their `zoom` is `true` or false: the wheel (with Ctrl or ⌘) magnifies them.

drag.title: Drag
drag.description: Dragging a network's node moves it, and it stays where it is dropped.

ItemAnchor.description: Text that follows a layout item: at the anchor `at` of its box, moved by `offset` pixels right and down; its label's block is aligned to the anchor (its top left corner at "top-left") unless its style says otherwise.

ItemCoordinate.description: A place along one axis on a layout item's box, as the frame drew it: its start (left or top, the default), middle, or end, moved by `offset` pixels, right for x and down for y. A row whose item is not drawn (none of its names, hidden, or too small) is left out.

ItemMeasure.description: A value each tree item has, which its paint may read: its share of its parent's value, its value, or its depth.

ItemName.description: One of a layout item's names, from the top: a category's value, or each row's value of a category field of the mark placed by it.

ItemPart.description: A part of an item's name after its mark's: a name, or an interval of a bin.

ItemRef.description: An item a layout mark (a pie, funnel, treemap, or sunburst) drew in the panel: the mark's `id`, and the item's names from the top (a tree node's path, a slice's or a stage's category).

ItemReference.description: An item named by the application where it has no key from an event yet: a mark's `id` and the parts of the item's name after it, as keys hold them: `{ mark: "brands", item: ["Coca-Cola"] }` (a bar keyed by brand), `{ mark: "lines", item: ["auth", 1767225600000] }` (the `auth` observation of a wide line keyed by time), `{ mark: "delays", item: [[0, 10]] }` (a histogram's bin from 0 to 10).

ItemSelection.description: Items chosen by clicks or keys (`interaction.select: "items"`) or set: bars, points, a line's observations, bins, cells, layout items. Only those items are selected, in their marks: another mark's item from the same row is not.

items.title: Items
items.description: Item keys, as events give them; the chart also takes references.

KeyGesture.description: A key, as `KeyboardEvent.key` names it, while the chart has the keyboard focus. Shift is not counted for single characters other than letters, which may need it ("+").

LabelAt.description: Which point of a series a label follows: its first or last observation drawn ("first", "last"), or where its line enters or leaves the view ("visible-start", "visible-end"), along the series' own order.

LabelContent.description: A label's text, its parts in order: `["Capacity: ", { value: true, format: { number: ".1f" } }]`.

LabelPart.description: One part of a label's text: literal text, a field's value of the row the label is at (written with `format`, else as the field's display writes it), the name of the series it labels (`{ series: true }`), its value there (`{ value: true }`, the value the geometry has at the label's place, written with `format`, else as its field's display writes it), or a field's label (`{ label }`, its name without one).

LabelPlaceSpec.description: Where a label goes on what it labels. `attachment` is along the geometry: a rule's start, middle, or end (left to right, or top to bottom), a region's edge (`side`, top by default) from its start, or a bar's root, middle, or tip. `outside` puts a label at a plot edge beyond it, and `reserve` keeps room for it there; `offset` moves it away from its place, in pixels.

LabelSpec.description: A label of an annotation (text, rule, region): its text (`LabelTextSpec`), placed as `place` says, kept apart from others as its layout says ("show" by default).

LayoutCellSpec.description: A cell of a grid: where it starts (from 0), how many tracks it spans (1 by default), and what it holds.

LayoutSpec.description: A layout: a grid of cells, or one panel.

LegendAction.description: What activating a legend entry does (see `LegendOptionsSpec.action`).

LegendEntrySpec.description: A legend entry of your own: its label, and either a swatch or a sample drawn as mark `sample.mark` draws its entries; with `targets`, clicking it hides and shows what they name. Its `key` is unique among the legend's own entries.

LegendGuideSpec.description: A legend: the entries of what it includes (all the chart's by default), laid out as its options say.

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: The id of the subplot (or inset) whose marks it lists: it goes above that panel by default, and its entries hide and show them there only. The chart's own legend then lists what no panel's legend does.

place.title: Place
place.description: Outside on a side (above the plots by default; on the left or right in a column), or inside a plot at a corner, over what it draws.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: Entries in this many columns, filled row by row (or as `order` says).

order.title: Order
order.description: Fill the grid row by row ("row", the default with `columns`) or down each column ("column", the default with `rows`).

include.title: Include
include.description: What the legend lists of the chart's scales and marks: every one a legend shows by default; `[]` for its own `entries` alone.

entries.title: Entries
entries.description: Entries of your own, after those `include` gives.

swatches.title: Swatches
swatches.description: Swatches that look like the marks: a dashed line for a dashed line, a symbol for points.

action.title: Action
action.description: What a click (or Enter) on an entry does: "hide" (the default) hides and shows what it names; "select" selects it, as a series selection (Shift adds it or takes it out; a click on the one selected clears it); `false`, nothing of the chart's own (`click` events still report it).

LegendInclude.description: What a legend lists: a scale's values, or a mark's entries.

LegendOptionsSpec.description: How a legend lays out and draws its entries, as the short form `legend` and legend guides take it.

place.title: Place
place.description: Outside on a side (above the plots by default; on the left or right in a column), or inside a plot at a corner, over what it draws.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: Entries in this many columns, filled row by row (or as `order` says).

order.title: Order
order.description: Fill the grid row by row ("row", the default with `columns`) or down each column ("column", the default with `rows`).

include.title: Include
include.description: What the legend lists of the chart's scales and marks: every one a legend shows by default; `[]` for its own `entries` alone.

entries.title: Entries
entries.description: Entries of your own, after those `include` gives.

swatches.title: Swatches
swatches.description: Swatches that look like the marks: a dashed line for a dashed line, a symbol for points.

action.title: Action
action.description: What a click (or Enter) on an entry does: "hide" (the default) hides and shows what it names; "select" selects it, as a series selection (Shift adds it or takes it out; a click on the one selected clears it); `false`, nothing of the chart's own (`click` events still report it).

tickLabel.title: Tick label
tickLabel.description: The labels of an axis' ticks, and the values a legend of a color ramp or a key writes.

legendTitle.title: Legend title
legendTitle.description: The titles of a legend's color ramps and keys.

LegendTarget.description: What a legend entry of your own hides and shows: a mark whole, the rows of a mark whose `field` holds one of `values`, or the values of one of the chart's scales (in every mark reading it). The entry is hidden when everything it targets is.

LegendTitleSpec.description: A legend's title: its text, or its text and how it looks.

Line3DSpec.description: Lines through (x, y, z) in a 3D chart: number or time fields, z vertical. Each series' rows, in table order, are one path; a row missing a value (or without a place on a log axis) breaks it. Lines share the chart's box with its other 3D marks.

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: The subplot whose 3D box this layer shares.

series.title: Series
series.description: Category field: one path per value, each with its color and legend entry.

stroke.title: Stroke
stroke.description: One color for every path; by default each series takes the chart's next.

strokeWidth.title: Stroke width
strokeWidth.description: Width in pixels, the same however near or far; default 2.

label.title: Label
label.description: Legend and tooltip name of the path without `series`.

itemKey.title: Item key
itemKey.description: A category, number, or time field whose value names each row's item. Without it, an item is its row (a bar: its position); rows sharing a value are one item, and a missing value names the row by its identity.

LineSpec.description: Lines through (x, y), along x, or along y with `orient: "y"` (or a category y). Several value fields (y, or x along y) or a series field give several lines. A category position places points at its bands' centers, in band order.

x.title: X
x.description: Positions along x, or with `orient: "y"` the values: one field or several, or a coordinate.

y.title: Y
y.description: Values along x (one field or several, or a coordinate), or with `orient: "y"` the positions.

series.title: Series
series.description: Category field that splits rows into one line per value. Without it, a category field as `color` splits them; `false` splits by neither.

dodge.title: Dodge
dodge.description: On a category position axis, with `series`: the series side by side in each band, as grouped bars are, instead of at its center.

stroke.title: Stroke
stroke.description: Constant color; otherwise colors come from the palette per series.

dash.title: Dash
dash.description: Pixel dash array, or a matplotlib style scaled by strokeWidth.

opacity.title: Opacity
opacity.description: From 0 to 1: the whole mark's, markers included.

curve.title: Curve
curve.description: How the line joins its points (see `Curve`); "linear" by default.

label.title: Label
label.description: Legend and tooltip name for a single-field line without `series`.

color.title: Color
color.description: The lines' color: a category field (a line per value, unless `series` says otherwise), or a color. The short form of `encode.color`; `stroke` wins over it.

encode.title: Encode
encode.description: Channels: color, stroke, dash, strokeWidth, and opacity. One reading rows (a field other than the series', a condition) changes the line's look along its series (style runs).

style.title: Style
style.description: Looks by series (`by`) and the markers' look.

markers.title: Markers
markers.description: A marker at each observation drawn: a circle (`true`) or the shape named.

where.title: Where
where.description: Rows the lines leave out, as gaps: they draw only where it holds.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: A label following each line: at its first or last point, or where it enters or leaves the view.

selected.title: Selected
selected.description: What a selection holds of the mark (items or series selected, or the rows a row selection highlights); as drawn by default.

unselected.title: Unselected
unselected.description: What it does not, while it holds something; by default at a quarter of its opacity.

clip.title: Clip
clip.description: What the mark's drawing is cut to. Without it, data is cut to the plot, and labels, rules, and text are drawn whole (those of values outside the plot are left out).

data.title: Data
data.description: Name of the table in `ChartSpec.data`; defaults to the only table.

id.title: Id
id.description: Stable identity, used for legend state and updates.

axis.title: Axis
axis.description: The y axis the mark's values are on: "left" (the default) or "right", the chart's `yRight` axis. Category y values stay on the left.

facet.title: Facet
facet.description: With the chart's `facet`, "repeat" draws all of the mark's rows in every panel instead of splitting them by the facet field.

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: With the chart's `panels`, the id of the panel the mark draws in, or "*" for every panel.

zIndex.title: Z index
zIndex.description: Where the mark is drawn among the others of its panel: higher above lower, marks of equal `zIndex` in the order they are listed. 0 by default; grid lines are at -1. Any finite number.

pick.title: Pick
pick.description: `false`: the pointer passes through the mark to what is under it (decorations).

inspect.title: Inspect
inspect.description: `false`: tooltips, hover, and the keyboard leave the mark out.

legend.title: Legend
legend.description: `false` leaves the mark's series, color ramps, and keys out of the chart's legends.

itemKey.title: Item key
itemKey.description: A category, number, or time field whose value names each row's item. Without it, an item is its row (a bar: its position); rows sharing a value are one item, and a missing value names the row by its identity.

LinkPart.description: A part of a link: literal text, a field of the row, or the field's own value.

LonLat.description: A longitude and a latitude in degrees: longitudes within a turn and a half of the meridian (shapes may cross the antimeridian), latitudes from pole to pole.

Look.description: A look laid over a mark's paint where a selection marks it out.

MarkAnchorSpec.description: A place on another mark's geometry that text follows: mark `mark`'s series at `at` (see `SeriesLabelsSpec`).

MarkRef.description: A mark a legend lists whole: its series, or for an annotation, what its label names (one entry, or one per value of its label's field).

MarkTooltipSpec.description: What a mark's tooltips show of the rows they are at.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Fields of the row the tooltip is at, shown in order under the mark's values: data that is not plotted, such as a request count. The keyboard's announcements and hover events read them too.

MarkerStyle.description: A point drawn at each observation of a line: its shape, radius, and paint (the line's color by default).

MissingDisplay.description: How missing values show: their text, their color where surfaces color values, or both.

Modifier.description: A key held with a gesture.

MoveItemAction.description: A network's node moves with a drag that starts on it.

NamePart.description: A part of a series' name: literal text, the series' own name (`{ series: true }`: its value field's label, or its series value as its field's display writes it), the value of a field constant within the series (`{ field }`: the mark's series field, or a line's or area's color field), written through its display, or a field's label (`{ label }`, its name without one).

NameSpec.description: A series mark's name: text naming its one series, or parts naming each series (`[{ series: true }, " p99"]`).

halo.title: Halo
halo.description: The outline that keeps the mark's text readable over what it is drawn on: "auto" (the default), false for none, or a color of its own.

height.title: Height
height.description: The strip's height in CSS pixels, from 16 up: 40 by default, at most a third of the height the plots and the strip share, and less where the plots would keep less than 30 pixels (or a row of several panels less than 20). A chart too short for a 16-pixel strip beside them has none.

marks.title: Marks
marks.description: The `id`s of the marks the strip draws, in the chart's order, whichever panels draw them; by default every line, area, point, vertical bar, and candlestick mark. An empty list draws none: the strip has its axis and window only.

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: The panel whose x scale the window moves (a subplot's id or a facet panel's key): the strip draws the marks of the panels sharing that scale, under all the panels. By default the x scale every panel shares.

NumberFormatSpec.description: How numbers are written: Intl.NumberFormat options; `{ number }`, a d3-format pattern; `{ duration }`, lengths of time; or `{ si }` and `{ binary }`, a unit after a prefix.

NumberPatternFormat.description: A d3-format pattern, with text before and after it: 1234 with `{ number: ".3~s", suffix: " req/s" }` is "1.23k req/s".

OrbitAction.description: A 3D chart's camera turns with a drag.

OrdinalScaleSpec.description: A scale of categories with fixed outputs, shared by the marks that name it: every value takes the same color (or shape, dash, number) in every mark and panel reading it, from any table, before facets and hidden series, and keeps it while the data streams. With `domain`, its values in that order and only those (others take `unknown`); without, the values of the fields it reads, their dictionaries' order first. Values `map` leaves out take the theme's palette (or the channel's defaults) by their place in the domain. A chart declaring "color" colors every mark's series and fields through it, unless a channel names another; without it, values take the chart's colors of what they stand for (the same field of the same table; see docs/architecture/marks.md, "Identity and color").

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Which panels share the scale's mapping: every panel of the chart (the default), or each panel its own ("panel"), whose values then take places in that panel's domain.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: The values in order, and only those; legends list every one, drawn or not.

unknown.title: Unknown
unknown.description: For values outside an explicit `domain`: the theme's muted color by default.

Orient.description: Which axis a line or area runs along: the axis of its positions, which it is traced and read along ("x" or "y"). By default y when `y` is a category field and `x` holds values, as bars lie along a category y; otherwise x.

Overlap.description: What a label does where it would cover another of its overlap group: drawn at its place anyway ("show"), left out ("hide", those of lower `priority` first), or moved to the nearest free place its kind of label allows, and left out where none is ("move").

PageScrollAction.description: Nothing: the page scrolls or zooms as it would, and later bindings are not tried.

PanAction.description: Pans these axes (by default x, or a plane both ways): by a drag's or the wheel's movement, or for a key, by `step`, fractions of the view across and up ([0.1, 0] moves a tenth of the x range right).

PanelAxisSpec.description: A panel's own axis, or a 3D chart's z axis: an axis whose title is text (titles of parts are the chart's x, y, and yRight's, and axis guides').

type.title: Type
type.description: Inferred from the data when omitted: time fields get "time".

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: Fixed domain. Time domains are epoch milliseconds.

nice.title: Nice
nice.description: Extend the domain to round tick values. Default true for y, and for x when it measures horizontal bars.

zero.title: Zero
zero.description: Include zero in the domain. Default true for the value axis of areas and bars.

padding.title: Padding
padding.description: Room between the data and the plot's edges: "auto" by default (see `ScalePadding`).

grid.title: Grid
grid.description: Grid lines across the plot, and where they are drawn among the marks (`{ zIndex }`). Default true for y, and for x when it measures horizontal bars.

ticks.title: Ticks
ticks.description: Which ticks it draws: about how many (a number), one `every` so often, or exactly `values`.

format.title: Format
format.description: How tick labels are written: Intl options, or a pattern (`{ number: ",.2f" }`, `{ time: "%H:%M" }`).

tooltipFormat.title: Tooltip format
tooltipFormat.description: How tooltips, the keyboard's announcements, and crosshair labels write one value of the axis, such as `{ weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric" }` or `{ time: "%a %H:%M" }`, leaving tick labels as they are: as `format` takes them; `format` by default.

style.title: Style
style.description: How the axis' parts look: its line, ticks, tick labels, title, and grid lines.

PanelInteractionSpec.description: A panel's own `interaction`: the chart's settings but `sync`.

pan.title: Pan
pan.description: Dragging pans these axes (`true` is x; a map's or network's plane, both ways), the horizontal wheel (and Shift with the wheel) pans x, and double-click resets. Category axes do not pan. `zoom` pans as well, unless `pan` is false.

zoom.title: Zoom
zoom.description: Zooms these axes: the wheel with Ctrl or ⌘ held, a trackpad or touch pinch, and the + and − keys zoom, 0 and double-click reset, and dragging pans unless `pan` is false. `true` is x (category axes do not zoom); maps and networks zoom both ways (`true` or "xy"), 3D charts magnify their camera, and treemaps and sunbursts drill into nodes on a click (`true`).

brush.title: Brush
brush.description: Drag to select: a range along x or y, a rectangle ("xy"), or a freehand region ("lasso"), reported as `select` events while it is drawn and when released; a click clears it. With `zoom` on along the brush's axes, a brush zooms to what it covers instead (Shift-drag pans); lassos only select. Maps and networks take "lasso". With its settings, a brush that can be moved and resized, and cleared otherwise (see `BrushOptions`).

bindings.title: Bindings
bindings.description: Gestures bound to actions, matched in order before the presets' bindings: the first whose gesture matches the input, and whose action applies where it happens, takes it. A gesture may be bound once.

limits.title: Limits
limits.description: How far the view may go, and when it nears its ends, per scale ("x", "y", "yRight").

rotate.title: Rotate
rotate.description: Dragging turns 3D charts; true by default. Their `zoom` is `true` or false: the wheel (with Ctrl or ⌘) magnifies them.

drag.title: Drag
drag.description: Dragging a network's node moves it, and it stays where it is dropped.

PanelLayoutSpec.description: A place for one of the chart's panels, named by its id, with the panels drawn over its plot.

camera.title: Camera
camera.description: The initial camera of a 3D subplot; omitted settings use the chart camera.

id.title: Id
id.description: Unique among the panels; marks name it in their `panel`.

title.title: Title
title.description: Drawn above the panel: its text, or its text and how it looks.

style.title: Style
style.description: Styles of what the panel draws: its plot's background and border, and its axes' parts.

x.title: X
x.description: The panel's x axis: the chart's `x`, with these settings in place of its own (`format` replaces the chart's whole). Panels sharing an x scale take their first panel's.

y.title: Y
y.description: The panel's y axis: the chart's `y`, with these settings in place of its own (`format` replaces the chart's whole).

yRight.title: Y right
yRight.description: The panel's right y axis, for its marks with `axis: "right"`: the chart's `yRight`, with these settings.

interaction.title: Interaction
interaction.description: How the panel answers input: the chart's `interaction`, with these settings in place of its own, one by one; `bindings` replaces the chart's list, and each scale's `limits` replace the chart's for that scale (`{}` clears them). Panels sharing a scale must agree on its limits. What the chart shares with other charts is the chart's (`interaction.sync`, whose channels name a panel to share its scales).

PanelStyles.description: The roles a panel's own style gives everything it draws.

panelTitle.title: Panel title
panelTitle.description: Subplots' titles and facet panels' headers.

tickLabel.title: Tick label
tickLabel.description: The labels of an axis' ticks, and the values a legend of a color ramp or a key writes.

axisLine.title: Axis line
axisLine.description: An axis' line along the plot.

PanelTitleSpec.description: A panel's title and how it looks; `align` puts it in the plot's width.

PartStyle.description: How a part of a label looks over the label's style: its size, weight, slant, color, and opacity. Its halo, box, and alignment are the label's.

PieSpec.description: A pie or donut: a slice per category, its angle in proportion to the sum of `value` over the category's rows (or their count). Slices hidden through the legend leave the rest to fill the circle.

data.title: Data
data.description: Name of the table in `ChartSpec.data`; defaults to the only table.

id.title: Id
id.description: Stable identity, used for legend state and updates.

category.title: Category
category.description: Category field: a slice per value.

value.title: Value
value.description: Number field summed per category; without it, slices count rows.

innerRadius.title: Inner radius
innerRadius.description: The hole's radius as a fraction of the pie's: 0 (the default) for a pie, about 0.6 for a donut.

sort.title: Sort

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Labels beside the slices, joined to them by lines; true by default.

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: With the chart's `panels`, the id of the panel the pie has to itself.

PinchGesture.description: Two fingers moving apart or together. Trackpad pinches arrive as the wheel with Ctrl held.

Place.description: Where a guide goes: outside on a side, or inside a plot.

PlotStyle.description: A plot's area: a background under its grid lines and a border around it.

Point3DSpec.description: Points at (x, y, z) in a 3D chart: number or time fields, z vertical. Points share the chart's box with the chart's other 3D marks.

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: The subplot whose 3D box this layer shares.

series.title: Series
series.description: A category field: a series per value; by default a category `color` field, and `false` for none.

labelField.title: Label field
labelField.description: Category field naming each point, for tooltips and keyboard reading.

color.title: Color
color.description: A number field colored on a continuous scale, with a color legend.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: Colors for `color`, low to high, or a scheme name such as "viridis".

label.title: Label
label.description: Legend and tooltip name of points without `series`.

itemKey.title: Item key
itemKey.description: A category, number, or time field whose value names each row's item. Without it, an item is its row (a bar: its position); rows sharing a value are one item, and a missing value names the row by its identity.

PointSpec.description: Points at (x, y), scatter plots: a radius of 2.5 pixels, or sizes from 2 to 12 pixels, by default.

x.title: X
x.description: A number, time, or category field (a category field places points in its bands), or a coordinate.

series.title: Series
series.description: A category field: a series per value. By default a category `color` field; `false` for none, each point colored by its row's `color`.

stroke.title: Stroke
stroke.description: Outline color of every point; the chart's background with only `strokeWidth`.

strokeWidth.title: Stroke width
strokeWidth.description: Outline width in pixels: 1 with only `stroke`, none by default.

fillOpacity.title: Fill opacity
fillOpacity.description: Opacity from 0 to 1, a number field mapped from 0.15 to 1, or a channel (`{ field, scale }`, a field through one of the chart's scales).

color.title: Color
color.description: A number or time field colored on a continuous scale (see `colors`), a category field (its values' colors, and the series it names), or a channel: `{ field, scale }` through one of the chart's scales, or `{ field, scale: { type: "identity" } }` for colors the data holds.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: Colors for `color`, low to high, or a scheme name such as "viridis".

colorDomain.title: Color domain
colorDomain.description: The values at the ends of the color ramp; the field's extent by default.

colorMidpoint.title: Color midpoint
colorMidpoint.description: The value at the ramp's middle, for diverging schemes such as "rdbu".

symbol.title: Symbol
symbol.description: A shape's name ("circle", "square", "triangle", ...), or a category field with a shape per value: `{ field }`, as herceg writes it (with `scale` naming one of the chart's scales that maps values to shapes), or the field's name when no shape has it. A name that is both is refused.

encode.title: Encode
encode.description: Channels of each point: color, fill, stroke, strokeWidth, opacity, symbol, and size.

size.title: Size
size.description: A point's area in square pixels. Areas in square pixels.

sampling.title: Sampling
sampling.description: "pixel" draws opaque points sharing a device pixel once. Default "none".

dodge.title: Dodge
dodge.description: With `series` and a category `x` or `y`, the series side by side in each band, as grouped bars are.

jitter.title: Jitter
jitter.description: With a category `x` or `y`, points spread across their band (or their dodged share of it) over `width`, a fraction of it from 0 to 1, by a hash of each row's identity and `seed` (0 by default).

swarm.title: Swarm
swarm.description: With a category `x` or `y`, points packed across their band (or their dodged share of it) without overlap, in order of their values, as a beeswarm; points that do not fit stand at its edges.

selected.title: Selected
selected.description: What a selection holds of the mark (items or series selected, or the rows a row selection highlights); as drawn by default.

unselected.title: Unselected
unselected.description: What it does not, while it holds something; by default at a quarter of its opacity.

clip.title: Clip
clip.description: What the mark's drawing is cut to. Without it, data is cut to the plot, and labels, rules, and text are drawn whole (those of values outside the plot are left out).

data.title: Data
data.description: Name of the table in `ChartSpec.data`; defaults to the only table.

id.title: Id
id.description: Stable identity, used for legend state and updates.

axis.title: Axis
axis.description: The y axis the mark's values are on: "left" (the default) or "right", the chart's `yRight` axis. Category y values stay on the left.

facet.title: Facet
facet.description: With the chart's `facet`, "repeat" draws all of the mark's rows in every panel instead of splitting them by the facet field.

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: With the chart's `panels`, the id of the panel the mark draws in, or "*" for every panel.

zIndex.title: Z index
zIndex.description: Where the mark is drawn among the others of its panel: higher above lower, marks of equal `zIndex` in the order they are listed. 0 by default; grid lines are at -1. Any finite number.

pick.title: Pick
pick.description: `false`: the pointer passes through the mark to what is under it (decorations).

inspect.title: Inspect
inspect.description: `false`: tooltips, hover, and the keyboard leave the mark out.

legend.title: Legend
legend.description: `false` leaves the mark's series, color ramps, and keys out of the chart's legends.

itemKey.title: Item key
itemKey.description: A category, number, or time field whose value names each row's item. Without it, an item is its row (a bar: its position); rows sharing a value are one item, and a missing value names the row by its identity.

size.title: Size
size.description: A channel through one of the chart's scales (`{ field, scale }`), giving each point's area in square pixels.

Position.description: A point: a coordinate on each axis, which may mix kinds (a data y at a fraction of the plot's width).

ProjectionName.description: A map projection: "equal-earth" (equal-area, for world maps), "natural-earth" (a compromise for world maps), "mercator" (conformal, cut at 85.05 degrees of latitude), "equirectangular" (longitude and latitude as they are), or "conic-equal-area" (Albers' equal-area conic, for countries and continents).

centralMeridian.title: Central meridian
centralMeridian.description: The longitude at the map's center, in degrees east: 0 by default; for "conic-equal-area", the middle of the data (or of `fit`).

parallels.title: Parallels
parallels.description: The two standard parallels of "conic-equal-area", in degrees: by default a sixth of the data's span of latitudes in from either end.

fit.title: Fit
fit.description: What the map fits into its plot: the data's shapes and points ("data", the default), the whole "world", or a box of longitudes and latitudes, `[[west, south], [east, north]]`, whose west may lie east of its east to cross the antimeridian.

RadarSpec.description: A radar: spokes from a center, evenly spaced clockwise from the top, and a polygon per series joining its value on each spoke. Spokes are the values of `category` (with `value` the number on each) or the number `fields`; one of the two forms, with 3 to 100 spokes. Every spoke shares one linear scale from the center.

halo.title: Halo
halo.description: The outline that keeps the mark's text readable over what it is drawn on: "auto" (the default), false for none, or a color of its own.

category.title: Category
category.description: Category field: a spoke per value, with `value` the number on it.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Distinct number fields, a spoke each, in order; each series' last row is its polygon.

series.title: Series
series.description: Category field: a polygon per value. Without it, every row belongs to one polygon.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: Values at the center and at the rim; from 0 (or the smallest value) to a round number above the largest by default.

fillOpacity.title: Fill opacity
fillOpacity.description: Opacity of the polygons' fill; 0.15 by default.

points.title: Points
points.description: A dot at each value; true by default.

label.title: Label
label.description: Name of the polygon of a radar without `series`, and of its values in tooltips.

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: With the chart's `panels`, the id of the panel the radar has to itself.

RankSpec.description: A rank test: true for the rows whose value of `field` (numbers or times) is among the `top` (or `bottom`) n of the mark's rows, before level of detail, facets, and hidden series. Values tied with the nth are in; missing and infinite values never are.

RegionSpec.description: Shaded regions: from `x1` to `x2` across the plot's height, from `y1` to `y2` across its width, or rectangles with both; or bands at a field's thresholds. Drawn in mark order, so list them before the marks they highlight to draw them underneath.

halo.title: Halo
halo.description: The outline that keeps the mark's text readable over what it is drawn on: "auto" (the default), false for none, or a color of its own.

fill.title: Fill
fill.description: Defaults to the theme's muted color.

stroke.title: Stroke
stroke.description: An outline: its color, and width in pixels (1 by default with a stroke).

strokeSides.title: Stroke sides
strokeSides.description: Which of the outline's sides are drawn: top, right, bottom, left (all by default).

encode.title: Encode
encode.description: Each row's paint, for regions of a table: `color` (the fill) or `fill`, `stroke`, and `opacity`, which scales the fill's `fillOpacity` and the outline's. Regions are drawn in row order whatever their looks.

label.title: Label
label.description: Text drawn in every region (in its top left corner by default), constant or each row's `field`; it draws no leader.

clip.title: Clip
clip.description: What the mark's drawing is cut to. Without it, data is cut to the plot, and labels, rules, and text are drawn whole (those of values outside the plot are left out).

contributeDomain.title: Contribute domain
contributeDomain.description: Whether the annotation's values count toward the axes' domains, so the view widens to keep them in it; false by default, so annotations show where the data is. Fractions and pixels never count.

legend.title: Legend
legend.description: `true` lists the annotation in the chart's legends by its label: one entry for constant text, one per value of its label's field, which hide and show what they name. Annotations are left out by default.

RowChannelsSpec<string>.description: A row channel, or row channels tried in order (see `ChannelsSpec`).

RowCoordinate.description: A place each row of a mark of rows has along an axis, read from its own value: a field on a scale (the axis' own by default), or a number field's share of a frame or pixels from its edge, as in `Coordinate`.

RowPosition.description: Where a mark drawing rows places them along an axis: a field, or a coordinate a field gives (see `RowCoordinate`): `{ field, scale }` on a position scale of the chart's `scales`, `{ fraction: { field } }` of the plot, `{ px: { field } }` from its edge, each moved `offset` pixels.

RowSelectionSpec.description: A chart's binding to a channel of a table's selection store (see `ChartSpec.rowSelection`).

data.title: Data

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: The store's channel the chart writes its selections to and highlights.

events.title: Events
events.description: The gestures that write to the channel: all three by default; none for a chart that only highlights. They write only where `interaction.brush` draws a brush or a lasso; a brush that writes rows never zooms.

effect.title: Effect
effect.description: "highlight" (the default) dims the rows the channel does not hold; "none" leaves them.

live.title: Live
live.description: The channel hears a brush's previews while it moves, and its cancel; commits only by default.

selection.title: Selection
selection.description: What the channel holds once loaded, in a store `loadSpec` makes (a store given in its options keeps what it holds), which static exports of the spec draw: a condition (rows appended later that meet it are selected too), or rows by position in the table. Left out, nothing is selected; `{ "kind": "rows", "rows": [] }` selects no row, dimming every one.

RugSpec.description: Individual observations as short ticks standing at a plot edge.

color.title: Color

length.title: Length

drag.description: Dragging the rule moves it along its axis: `itemMove` events report its value as it moves (`preview`), where it is dropped (`commit`), and Escape or a lost pointer (`cancel`). span.title: Span

label.title: Label
