SankeySpec.description: A Sankey diagram of flows between nodes, from a table with a row per flow. Nodes are the names in `source` and `target`; a link joins each source and target, as thick as the sum of `value` over their rows (or their count). Rows without a positive, finite value, links from a node to itself, and links that would close a cycle are left out.

halo.title: Halo
halo.description: The outline that keeps the mark's text readable over what it is drawn on: "auto" (the default), false for none, or a color of its own.

source.title: Source
source.description: Category field naming where each row's flow comes from.

target.title: Target
target.description: Category field naming where it goes; a name in both fields is one node.

value.title: Value
value.description: Number field summed per source and target; without it, links count rows.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Names and values beside the nodes that have room for them; true by default.

nodeWidth.title: Node width
nodeWidth.description: Width of the node bars in pixels; 12 by default.

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Order of the nodes in each column: by default, the order that keeps links short and crossings few; "input" keeps the order in which nodes first appear in the table, "value" puts the largest first.

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: With the chart's `panels`, the id of the panel the Sankey diagram has to itself.

ScaleLimitsSpec.description: How far the view of a scale may go, and when it nears its ends. Every view asked for keeps inside `extent` (pans keep their span; a view wider than the extent shows the extent), whoever asks: the pointer, keys, `setViewport`, a brush, or a synced chart. A view fitted to the data (the first, or after a reset) shows the data, or the axis' `domain`.

extent.title: Extent
extent.description: The values the view may show, epoch ms on time axes; null for no end on that side.

edge.title: Edge
edge.description: Reports an `edge` event when the view comes within `threshold` (a fraction of its span, 0.1 by default) of an end of the extent, or, on an x scale every panel shares, of the data where the extent has none, and again only once it has moved `hysteresis` (0.05) farther away, or the end moved. `true` takes the defaults.

ScalePadding.description: Room between the data and a plot's edges, along a position scale: "auto" (the default) leaves room for what marks draw at their values (markers whole, bars' widths) on domains fitted to the data, and keeps explicit domains and views exact; a number widens the domain by that share of its span at each end (`[a, b]` becomes `[a - p(b - a), b + p(b - a)]`, in the scale's transformed space: logs on a log scale), from 0 up to but not including 0.5; `{ px }` keeps that many pixels at each end. 0 turns automatic room off.

ScaleRef.description: A scale a guide shows: one a mark owns, by the mark's `id` and the channel (its series colors, "series"; a color field's ramp or colors, "color", which are its series' where its color splits them; its sizes, "size"; or its symbols, "symbol"), or one of the chart's `scales` by name (`{ scale }`), with every value any mark reads through it. Guides naming a mark show it whatever its `legend` setting.

ScaleScope.description: Which panels share one instance of a scale, with one domain (each panel keeps its own pixel range): every panel of the chart (insets aside), each panel alone, the panels of a row or of a column (of a facet grid, or of the layout grid holding them), the panels on the same rows or columns of the layout grid `layout` names (a nested grid's panels by the cell holding it), or the panels `panels` lists. A category scale that panels do not share holds only the categories of the rows they draw, and its type comes from the marks of its own panels, so subplots can put categories on one panel's axis and numbers on another's. Histograms choose their bins from the rows of the panels sharing an x scale.

ScaleSpec.description: A position scale's settings: the short forms `x`, `y`, and `yRight` hold these with their axes' settings. Under another name in the chart's `scales`, a position scale of its own, which marks place values on with `{ field, scale }` and which has no axis unless an axis guide names it; such a scale gives its `type`.

type.title: Type
type.description: Inferred from the data when omitted: time fields get "time".

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: Fixed domain. Time domains are epoch milliseconds.

nice.title: Nice
nice.description: Extend the domain to round values (see the short forms).

padding.title: Padding
padding.description: Room between the data and the plot's edges along the scale.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Which panels share one instance of the scale.

tooltipFormat.title: Tooltip format
tooltipFormat.description: How tooltips, the keyboard, and crosshair labels write one value; the axis' format by default.

ScalesSpec.description: The chart's scales by name: the position scales x, the left y, and the right y, scales of categories ("color", which color fields read unless they name another, "symbol", "dash", or names marks give), identity scales, and channel scales, which map numbers onto widths, opacities, sizes, and colors (those with a `range`).

SelectionGesture.description: What selects rows in a chart bound to a selection store: range and rectangle brushes, lassos, and clicks.

SelectionSpec.description: A selection of a table's rows: a condition on its fields, or rows by position, a uint32 buffer index or a JSON array.

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: A uint32 buffer's index, or the rows' positions in the table.

SelectionSyncSpec.description: The selection's channel: its group's name, what of selections it carries ("xy", all, by default), and the panel whose scales carry it (see `SyncChannelSpec`).

SeriesLabelsSpec.description: Labels that follow each series of a line: placed at `at`, saying `content` (the series' name by default), placed as `place` says (beside the point within the plot, or `outside` the plot at its edge) and styled as `style` says. A panel's series labels keep apart as `overlap` says: "move" (the default) moves them along y as little as keeps them apart, in the order of their points, and leaves out those of lowest `priority` (then the last in series order) where the plot is too short for all; "show" draws each at its point; "hide" leaves out those that would cover one of higher priority. `leader` draws a line from each label moved more than 6 pixels back to its point.

SeriesReference.description: A series named by the application: a mark's `id`, and a value field or a series field's value.

SeriesSelection.description: Series chosen by clicks or keys (`interaction.select: "series"`) or set.

series.title: Series
series.description: Series keys, as events and the legend give them; the chart also takes references.

SeriesStyle.description: How one series (or, for marks of rows, one row) looks: its paint, and a line's markers.

SiFormat.description: Numbers with SI prefixes, by thousands from n to E, before the unit `si`: 1500000 with `{ si: "B" }` is "1.5 MB", 0.45 with `{ si: "W" }` "450 mW". The prefix is chosen after rounding; values are in the unit already.

si.title: Si
si.description: The unit's symbol, written after the prefix.

decimals.title: Decimals
decimals.description: Decimals, kept when zero; by default up to 1, zeros dropped.

Side.description: A side of the chart or of a panel's plot.

SidePlace.description: Outside the plots, on a side: in a track of its own, the room it takes kept from the plots. With `scope: "chart"` (the default) it is beside the whole figure, every panel included; with `scope: "panel"` beside the plot of panel `panel` (the first one by default).

align.title: Align
align.description: Where along the side: its start (left or top), center, or end.

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: Pixels between it and what it is beside, more than the usual gap.

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: With `scope: "panel"`, the key of the panel (a subplot's id, a facet's value).

Snap.description: Which point of each series an inspection along an axis reads: "shared" (the default), the value nearest the pointer that any series has, and every series' point there; "each", each series' own point nearest the pointer (ties to the earlier), the crosshair at the pointer; "previous", each series' last point at or before the pointer (an hourly series' 10:00 for 10:37), the crosshair at the latest read; "next", each series' first point at or after it, the crosshair at the earliest read. A series reads nothing inside a gap its `continuity` leaves, nor past `within`. "previous" and "next" read series sorted along the axis; series drawn in another order read nothing.

StackSpec.description: How an area stack piles its series: `offset` ("zero", "fill" for shares, "center" or "wiggle" for streams), the layers' `order` (as listed, or "inside-out", the largest in the middle), and what a series of a series field counts as at a position other series have rows at but it has not (`gaps`): zero, or the straight line between its rows on either side ("interpolate"; zero beyond its first and last rows), and where the stack stands (`support`): wherever any series has a row ("union"), or only where every shown series has one or runs across ("intersection"). A series' run that its `continuity` breaks is a gap of the whole stack.

StrokeStyle.description: How a line looks: its color, width in pixels, dash pattern, and opacity.

StyleMapSpec.description: Looks by value: each series whose `field` (constant within it) has a value `map` names takes that look. Without `field`, series are named by their source: a `series` field's value, or the value field of wide data (`y: ["mean", "p95"]`). Marks of rows (bars, points) read each row's value.

StyleRoles.description: Styles by visual role. A theme gives every role its defaults; a guide or panel gives the roles it draws. Text roles start from `text`.

text.title: Text
text.description: Every text's base: the font and size most of all.

panelTitle.title: Panel title
panelTitle.description: Subplots' titles and facet panels' headers.

tickLabel.title: Tick label
tickLabel.description: The labels of an axis' ticks, and the values a legend of a color ramp or a key writes.

legendTitle.title: Legend title
legendTitle.description: The titles of a legend's color ramps and keys.

axisLine.title: Axis line
axisLine.description: An axis' line along the plot.

crosshair.title: Crosshair
crosshair.description: The line the pointer's, the keyboard's, and other charts' cursors draw across a plot.

line.title: Line
line.description: Lines, area outlines, and contour lines that do not set their own width.

bar.title: Bar
bar.description: Bars: the radius of the corners at the value end of unstacked bars; 0 for square bars.

tooltip.title: Tooltip
tooltip.description: The tooltip's box; its text is the theme's text color.

SunburstLabelsSpec.description: A sunburst's names: across the sector ("horizontal", the default), or along its radius, upright ("radial").

SunburstSpec.description: A sunburst: a tree as rings around a center, each node's angle its share of its parent's, deeper levels further out.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Names inside the sectors that have room for them; true by default.

innerRadius.title: Inner radius
innerRadius.description: The center kept empty of rings, as a fraction of the sunburst's radius; 0.18 by default.

center.title: Center
center.description: A drilled sunburst's root painted in its center (true, the default); `false` leaves the center empty, and a click there still goes up.

gap.title: Gap
gap.description: Pixels between neighboring sectors and between rings; 2 by default.

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: With the chart's `panels`, the id of the panel the sunburst has to itself.

levels.title: Levels
levels.description: Levels drawn below the tree's root (the drill root); every level by default.

SurfaceSpec.description: A surface over a grid in a 3D chart: each row is a grid point, at the distinct values of `x` and `y` (numbers or times in order, categories evenly spaced in dictionary order), at the height of `z`. Cells between four grid points with values are drawn; points without a value leave holes.

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: The subplot whose 3D box this layer shares.

z.title: Z
z.description: Number field: the height at each grid point.

color.title: Color
color.description: A number field coloring the surface in place of `z`.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: Colors from low to high values, or a scheme name; the theme's ramp by default.

shading.title: Shading
shading.description: Shades cells by how they face a light above and behind the viewer; true by default. Without shading, colors read exactly as the legend shows.

wireframe.title: Wireframe
wireframe.description: Draws the grid's lines over the surface; false by default.

label.title: Label
label.description: What the surface is, in tooltips.

SwatchSpec.description: A sample drawn for a legend entry: a line, a filled box, or a point's symbol ("circle" by default; `size` pixels across, 10 by default), outlined by a 1-pixel `stroke`, or several over each other. An entry can also show a mark's look by its `sample` of the mark.

SymbolName.description: A point's shape. Every shape covers the area of a circle of the same radius; "cross" is a plus and "x" the same turned 45 degrees.

SyncChannelSpec.description: A sync channel: its group's name and the chart's scale it carries, of the panel `panel` names (a subplot's id or a facet panel's key), or by default the one every panel shares.

SyncSpec.description: The channels a chart shares, each with the charts of its group (a name alone, or with the scale that carries it): the cursor's position and the view's range along x by default, and the selection whole (its x and y ranges and lassos). Values travel as data: times as epoch ms, categories by name. A chart along y follows one along x with `scale: "y"`; a selection's range along one axis is shared alone with `scale: "x"` or "y". `panels` shares the cursor among the chart's own panels.

panels.title: Panels
panels.description: The cursor across the chart's own panels (facets, subplots): where the pointer or keyboard is in one, the others show a crosshair and their points at the same x. On by default for panels sharing an x scale; `true` or `{ snap?, tooltip? }` also for panels with x scales of their own (the value read on each one's scale); `false` turns it off.

TextLabelSpec.description: Text's label: its text (`LabelTextSpec`), kept apart from others as its layout says (`LabelLayoutSpec`). Text at a place is drawn there, where "move" may move it around its point, and keeps apart from the labels of its `overlapGroup`; text following a series (`from`) is placed as series' labels are (`place`: outside the plot, keeping room or not, and its offset), and takes no group.

TextSpec.description: Text at a place (`at`, or `x` and `y`): constant `label` text, or each row's `label.field`. Labels are drawn above the data and left out when their place is outside the plot.

halo.title: Halo
halo.description: The outline that keeps the mark's text readable over what it is drawn on: "auto" (the default), false for none, or a color of its own.

at.title: At
at.description: Where the text is: a coordinate on each axis, of any kinds (a fraction of the plot's width at a data value).

from.title: From
from.description: Where the text is on another mark's geometry, following it: the series of mark `from.mark` at `from.at`, such as where a line leaves the view, one label per series; or with `from.item`, the item of a layout mark each row names, at an anchor of its box. Not with `x`, `y`, or `at`.

clip.title: Clip
clip.description: What the mark's drawing is cut to. Without it, data is cut to the plot, and labels, rules, and text are drawn whole (those of values outside the plot are left out).

data.title: Data
data.description: Name of the table in `ChartSpec.data`; defaults to the only table.

id.title: Id
id.description: Stable identity, used for legend state and updates.

axis.title: Axis
axis.description: The y axis the mark's values are on: "left" (the default) or "right", the chart's `yRight` axis. Category y values stay on the left.

facet.title: Facet
facet.description: With the chart's `facet`, "repeat" draws all of the mark's rows in every panel instead of splitting them by the facet field.

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: With the chart's `panels`, the id of the panel the mark draws in, or "*" for every panel.

zIndex.title: Z index
zIndex.description: Where the mark is drawn among the others of its panel: higher above lower, marks of equal `zIndex` in the order they are listed. 0 by default; grid lines are at -1. Any finite number.

pick.title: Pick
pick.description: `false`: the pointer passes through the mark to what is under it (decorations).

inspect.title: Inspect
inspect.description: `false`: tooltips, hover, and the keyboard leave the mark out.

itemKey.title: Item key
itemKey.description: A category, number, or time field whose value names each row's item. Without it, an item is its row (a bar: its position); rows sharing a value are one item, and a missing value names the row by its identity.

contributeDomain.title: Contribute domain
contributeDomain.description: Whether the annotation's values count toward the axes' domains, so the view widens to keep them in it; false by default, so annotations show where the data is. Fractions and pixels never count.

legend.title: Legend
legend.description: `true` lists the annotation in the chart's legends by its label: one entry for constant text, one per value of its label's field, which hide and show what they name. Annotations are left out by default.

TextStyle.description: How text looks. Every property is optional: what a level of the cascade leaves out it inherits. Text takes its color from `color`, never `fill`.

lineHeight.title: Line height
lineHeight.description: The distance between lines of text, as a multiple of `fontSize`; 1.25 by default.

align.title: Align
align.description: Where text sits in the span it is placed in: the chart's width for its title, the plot's for a panel's title, an axis' length for its title; for text placed at a point (text marks, labels of rules, regions, and series, flat tick labels along x), which side of its block, or its middle, is there. Each text has a natural alignment when this is left out (a chart's title starts at the left, an axis title is centered).

verticalAlign.title: Vertical align
verticalAlign.description: Where a block of text stands across its lines from the point it is placed at: that point at its top, middle, or bottom (its box's edge, when it has a background), before any turn. For text marks, labels of rules, regions, and series, and flat tick labels along y (at their ticks). Each text has a natural placement when this is left out (a rule's label above it, tick labels centered on their ticks); titles and legends fill rows of their own, which it does not move them in.

background.title: Background
background.description: A box behind the text; `false` for none.

padding.title: Padding
padding.description: Room between the text and its box, in pixels.

ThemeName.description: A built-in theme. Each paints a background of its own (light, the default, white), except "auto": "light" or "dark" as the page behind the chart is, on a transparent background that shows the page, following its changes; "light" where there is no page.

ThemeSpec.description: Changes to a built-in theme: its tokens, the colors its styles are made of, and role styles (`style.title`, `style.tickLabel`, ...). Colors and fonts may be CSS variables, `var(--name)`: charts in a page read them where the chart is, and follow changes of the page's theme; elsewhere (static export) a variable needs a fallback, `var(--name, #2a78d6)`.

extends.title: Extends
extends.description: Base theme to extend; "light" by default.

ThemeTokens.description: A theme's tokens: the colors its role styles are made from. Changing a token changes every role that uses it (`muted` the tick labels, `axis` the axis lines and ticks), unless a role sets its own.

background.title: Background
background.description: The chart's background; "transparent" shows the page (or, in exports, what they are shown on).

sequential.title: Sequential
sequential.description: Ramp for continuous color (heatmaps), from low to high values.

diverging.title: Diverging
diverging.description: Ramp for colors on either side of a midpoint, low to high.

rise.title: Rise
rise.description: Colors of candlesticks that close at or above, and below, their open.

ThresholdPlace.description: A place at each step of the thresholds the chart's field displays give a number field (`fields`): a rule at each step's value, or a band from each step to the next. Places of no rows: one item per step.

thresholds.title: Thresholds
thresholds.description: The field whose display's thresholds give the places.

table.title: Table
table.description: The table whose field it is, by name, where the tables the chart's marks read give it different thresholds.

ThresholdStep.description: A step of thresholds: values from `value` up to the next step's take `color`.

Thresholds.description: Colors of a number field's values by step: a value takes the color of the last step at or below it, and values below the first step `base` (none by default: the surface's own paint). With `mode: "percent"`, step values are percents of the field's `min` to `max`, which it must give.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: "absolute" (the default): steps are values of the field; "percent": percents of its min to max.

base.title: Base
base.description: The color of values below the first step.

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: Steps in ascending order of value.

TickLabelsSpec.description: How a layer's tick labels are written and placed.

rotation.title: Rotation
rotation.description: Degrees clockwise, from -90 (reading up) to 90 (reading down); or angles tried in order, the first at which the labels fit.

overlap.title: Overlap
overlap.description: Overlapping labels: drawn all ("show"), the default for number and time axes, or as `TickOverlap` says.

row.title: Row
row.description: The row of labels, 0 by the axis line and 1 beyond it.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: Which labels stay where labels collide, the higher; 0 by default.

duplicates.title: Duplicates
duplicates.description: Labels that repeat the one before them: left blank, their ticks kept ("hide", the default), or drawn ("show").

inside.title: Inside
inside.description: Draw the labels inside the plot, beside their ticks, rather than outside it, taking none of the room outside; rows then advance inward. Flat labels, inside or out, stand at their ticks along the axis as `style.tickLabel` aligns them: on x its `align`, on y its `verticalAlign`; centered by default. Not on colorbars.

gap.title: Gap
gap.description: Pixels from the labels to their tick's end on their side (half a "cross" tick's length; the axis line where the tick does not reach their side), 0 or more.

TickLayerSpec.description: A layer of an axis' ticks: its own ticks, format, tick marks, and labels, such as minor ticks or a row of day boundaries under hourly labels. `false` leaves out its tick marks or labels.

id.title: Id
id.description: Unique among the axis' layers; "major" names the axis' own ticks.

style.title: Style
style.description: How its tick marks and labels look, over the axis'.

tickLabel.title: Tick label
tickLabel.description: The labels of an axis' ticks, and the values a legend of a color ramp or a key writes.

TickMarkSpec.description: Tick marks: out from the plot (the default), in over it, or across the axis line ("cross", half each way); `length` in pixels (for "cross", the whole length).

TickOverlap.description: What a row of tick labels does where labels would overlap: "show" draws them all; "hide" leaves out labels until the rest fit, those of higher `priority` last; "stagger" moves every other one to a second row; "wrap" breaks labels into lines.

TicksSpec.description: Which ticks an axis draws: about `count` round values (a number alone is the same); one every `every` (a number on number axes, from `anchor`, 0 by default; a time interval on time axes; on category axes, every n-th category); or exactly `values` (numbers, epoch milliseconds on time axes, or categories), those inside the axis' domain.

TimeBreakSpec.description: Time a time axis leaves out, in the chart's `timeZone`. Each break is one of: days of the week (`{ weekdays: ["sat", "sun"] }`), a daily span of wall-clock time (`{ hours: ["16:00", "09:30"] }`, wrapping past midnight when it ends earlier than it starts), whole calendar days (`{ dates: ["2025-12-25"] }`), or a span of instants (`{ from, to }`, epoch milliseconds). Starts are included, ends are not. Across a clock change, `hours` leaves out the instants whose wall-clock time is in the span, so a span inside a repeated hour is left out twice.

TimeColumnSpec.description: Epoch milliseconds or ISO 8601 strings; null for missing values.

TimeFormatSpec.description: How times are written: Intl.DateTimeFormat options, or `{ time }`, a strftime pattern.

TimeInterval.description: The time between ticks on a time axis: calendar steps in the scale's time zone, written as a unit ("day"), a count and a unit ("6 hours"), or `{ unit, step }`; or elapsed time, `{ milliseconds }`, which keeps the same length across daylight saving changes.

TimePatternFormat.description: A strftime pattern, in the scale's time zone, with years and quarters of a `fiscal` year if given.

TimeUnit.description: A calendar unit of time, as time axes step through it in their time zone.

TitlePart.description: A part of an axis' title: literal text, or a field's label (`{ label: "p99" }`).

TitleSpec.description: The chart's title with where it goes and how it looks.

place.title: Place
place.description: Above the chart (the default) or below it.

style.title: Style
style.description: `align` puts it at the start, center, or end of the chart's width.

TooltipField.description: A field of a row that tooltips show besides the mark's values: its name, or its name with a label (the name by default) and a format, as axes take them (number forms for number fields, time forms for times). Without a format, numbers are written as the chart's other numbers, times by the x axis' format when x is a time axis (else as dates and times), and categories as they are.

TooltipSpec.description: The tooltip's presentation; what it reads is the chart's `inspection`.

axisLabels.title: Axis labels
axisLabels.description: Label the crosshair on the axes, as financial charts do: the inspected value on the axis the crosshair follows, and the pointer's position on the other axes, across the plot at a dashed line. Off by default.

pin.title: Pin
pin.description: "click": a click (or Enter) on what the tooltip shows pins it there; its content then takes the pointer and the keyboard's focus, so links and buttons in it work. Escape, a click outside it, a click off the data, or a second click on what it shows lets it go. Pinned to an item (inspection "nearest", or layout items) it follows the item and closes once the item is gone; pinned to a value along the inspection's axis, every series is read there again as data changes, and it hides while the value is out of view. Off (`false`) by default.

TrackSpec.description: The size of a row or column of a grid, as the plots of the panels on it take it (their titles, axes, and legends take room beside them): a weight relative to the other flexible tracks (a number, or `{ weight }` with a least size `min` in pixels), or a fixed size (`{ px }`). Fixed tracks keep their size; flexible ones share what is left by weight.

TransformSpec.description:
One step of a derivation:
- `filter`: keeps rows where the expression is true.
- `calculate`: adds (or replaces) the field `as` with the expression's value.
- `bin`: replaces a number or time field (or adds `as`) with the start of its bin (`bins`: about how many round bins, 10 by default, a width and where bins start, or edges), and with `end` adds the bin's end.
- `aggregate`: one row per group of `by` values (one row without), with the group's fields and each operation's result.
- `rolling`: adds each operation over the trailing `size` rows (within each `by` group), in row order.
- `sort`: orders rows by a field, stably.

TreeLook.description: A look laid over tree items' paint: of a `Look`, a fill, a fill opacity, and an opacity it is multiplied by.

TreeOpacity.description: Tree items' fill opacity: a number from 0 to 1, or an item measure read through `range` linearly: shares from 0 to 1, values from 0 to the largest item's, depths from the top level to the deepest drawn.

TreemapLabelsSpec.description: A treemap's names: in each rectangle's top-left corner (the default) or its center; `parents: false` names only rectangles drawn without others inside them, and keeps no strip at the top of the others for names.

TreemapSpec.description: A treemap: nested rectangles for a tree whose leaves' areas are their share of `value` (or of the rows), as the portable spec describes it.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Names inside the rectangles that have room for them; true by default.

tile.title: Tile
tile.description: How children fill their parent: in rows kept close to square ("squarify", the default), or sliced along x, their children along y, and so on ("slice-dice", as a Marimekko's columns and cells).

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: With the chart's `panels`, the id of the panel the treemap has to itself.

levels.title: Levels
levels.description: Levels drawn below the tree's root (the drill root); every level by default.

ValueMapping.description: Values shown as `text` and in `color` (either, or both), matched by one value (a category, a number, or a time in epoch milliseconds), by a range of numbers or times (`between`, both ends included, null for an open end), or, for categories, by a regular expression (`regex`; `$1`, `$2` in `text` write its groups). The first mapping that matches a value applies: without `text` the value is written by the format, and without `color` it is colored by the thresholds.

ViewLimitsSpec.description: Limits of the views of the position scales, by name.

ViewSpec.description: The rows of the table `source` that `view` shows: those its filter keeps, in the order its sort gives (table order without), read from the table without a copy, and following it as it changes (`rowView`). Every mark that draws series takes a view; annotation and layout marks take tables.

ViewState.description: What a chart shows along each axis (null: not zoomed), as `setViewport` takes it.

ViewportState.description: The chart's view, or each panel's where panels zoom on their own.

ViolinSpec.description: Violins: per category, the Gaussian kernel density of a number field's values mirrored about the category's center, each as wide as the others at its densest, reaching two bandwidths past the extreme values. Inside each, a line between the box plot's whisker ends, a narrow box from the lower to the upper quartile, and a dot at the median. One of `x` and `y` is a category field, the other the values.

series.title: Series
series.description: Category field: a violin per value in each category, side by side.

color.title: Color
color.description: A category field naming the series, whose values color them (as `series` does, which must then name it too), or a color for every shape, as `fill` sets it.

split.title: Split
split.description: Two series share the category center: first left (below horizontally), second right (above).

inner.title: Inner
inner.description: Inner box (default), dashed quartiles with a solid median, or no inner marks.

bandwidth.title: Bandwidth
bandwidth.description: The kernel's standard deviation in data units, the same for every violin; by default each violin's by Silverman's rule of thumb.

fill.title: Fill
fill.description: Constant color for every shape; colors come from the palette otherwise.

fillOpacity.title: Fill opacity
fillOpacity.description: Opacity of the violins' fill; 0.25 by default.

selected.title: Selected
selected.description: What a selection holds of the mark (items or series selected, or the rows a row selection highlights); as drawn by default.

unselected.title: Unselected
unselected.description: What it does not, while it holds something; by default at a quarter of its opacity.

clip.title: Clip
clip.description: What the mark's drawing is cut to. Without it, data is cut to the plot, and labels, rules, and text are drawn whole (those of values outside the plot are left out).

data.title: Data
data.description: Name of the table in `ChartSpec.data`; defaults to the only table.

id.title: Id
id.description: Stable identity, used for legend state and updates.

axis.title: Axis
axis.description: The y axis the mark's values are on: "left" (the default) or "right", the chart's `yRight` axis. Category y values stay on the left.

facet.title: Facet
facet.description: With the chart's `facet`, "repeat" draws all of the mark's rows in every panel instead of splitting them by the facet field.

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: With the chart's `panels`, the id of the panel the mark draws in, or "*" for every panel.

zIndex.title: Z index
zIndex.description: Where the mark is drawn among the others of its panel: higher above lower, marks of equal `zIndex` in the order they are listed. 0 by default; grid lines are at -1. Any finite number.

pick.title: Pick
pick.description: `false`: the pointer passes through the mark to what is under it (decorations).

inspect.title: Inspect
inspect.description: `false`: tooltips, hover, and the keyboard leave the mark out.

legend.title: Legend
legend.description: `false` leaves the mark's series, color ramps, and keys out of the chart's legends.

VisibilityState.description: The keys hidden in the chart, and per subplot the keys its own legend hid and showed there unlike the rest of the chart.

Weekday.description: A day of the week, by its first three letters in English.

WheelGesture.description: The wheel (or a trackpad's two-finger scroll) along an axis, either by default: the axis it moves most along, x for Shift with a mouse wheel in browsers that report it so. With `focused`, only while the chart has the keyboard focus.

modifiers.title: Modifiers
modifiers.description: Keys held, exactly: none by default.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: Panels per row; by default about as many columns as rows.

header.title: Header
header.description: `false` draws no headers and keeps no room for them; panels are named by their headers by default.

gap.title: Gap
gap.description: Pixels between neighboring panels beyond the room their axes' labels and headers take: one for both, or each its own. Spaced to their labels by default.

XAxisSpec.description: The x axis: an axis whose time may leave out spans of time.

breaks.title: Breaks
breaks.description: Time the axis leaves out, so that what is left is drawn without gaps: weekends, hours outside trading sessions, holidays. Needs a time axis. Data inside a break is not drawn; lines and areas join the points on either side.

seams.title: Seams
seams.description: Dashed vertical lines behind data at time breaks' seams. Default false; needs time-axis breaks. Seams are kept in chronological order at least `minSpacing` CSS pixels apart (default 40), excluding plot edges.

type.title: Type
type.description: Inferred from the data when omitted: time fields get "time".

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: Fixed domain. Time domains are epoch milliseconds.

nice.title: Nice
nice.description: Extend the domain to round tick values. Default true for y, and for x when it measures horizontal bars.

zero.title: Zero
zero.description: Include zero in the domain. Default true for the value axis of areas and bars.

padding.title: Padding
padding.description: Room between the data and the plot's edges: "auto" by default (see `ScalePadding`).

title.title: Title
title.description: Axis title: text, or text and fields' labels (`[{ label: "p99" }]`).

grid.title: Grid
grid.description: Grid lines across the plot, and where they are drawn among the marks (`{ zIndex }`). Default true for y, and for x when it measures horizontal bars.

ticks.title: Ticks
ticks.description: Which ticks it draws: about how many (a number), one `every` so often, or exactly `values`.

format.title: Format
format.description: How tick labels are written: Intl options, or a pattern (`{ number: ",.2f" }`, `{ time: "%H:%M" }`).

tooltipFormat.title: Tooltip format
tooltipFormat.description: How tooltips, the keyboard's announcements, and crosshair labels write one value of the axis, such as `{ weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric" }` or `{ time: "%a %H:%M" }`, leaving tick labels as they are: as `format` takes them; `format` by default.

style.title: Style
style.description: How the axis' parts look: its line, ticks, tick labels, title, and grid lines.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Which panels share one instance of the scale: in facets, the whole chart by default for x and y; in subplots, each panel; for yRight, as y. Only charts with facets or panels have several.

repeat.title: Repeat
repeat.description: Where panels sharing the scale label it: "outer" (the default) only on the outer edge of panels lined up on the same rows or columns, below the lowest and beside the first (on the right, the last); "all" on every panel.

ZoomAction.description: Zooms these axes (as `pan`): the wheel and pinches about the pointer, a double click there by `factor` (2 by default), and a key about the plot's middle by `factor` (1.25 by default); a factor above 1 zooms in.
